````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.ui.components

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.horizontalScroll
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.rememberScrollState
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.material3.TextButton
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.rememberSaveable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.nativeCanvas
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.*
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.window.Dialog
import androidx.compose.ui.window.DialogProperties
import com.electrokit.app.R
import com.electrokit.app.data.Diagram
import kotlin.math.*

/**
 * Draws recognisable original hardware illustrations without substituting invented contact layouts.
 *
 * @param diagram Dataset caption and logical contacts; the table remains the wiring reference.
 * @param modifier Parent layout constraints.
 * @param enlarged True renders a larger scrollable inspection drawing without another expand
 *   action.
 * @return True when this renderer handled the drawing, false for existing specialised schematics.
 *   Malformed optional geometry falls back to the existing renderer; drawing failures propagate.
 */
@Composable
fun illustratedConnector(
    diagram: Diagram,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    enlarged: Boolean = false,
): Boolean {
    var expanded by rememberSaveable(diagram.caption) { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val kind = diagram.shape.removePrefix("illustration:")
    if (!diagram.shape.startsWith("illustration:")) return false
    val detailed = kind in setOf("board", "dip", "regulator")
    Column(
        modifier
            .padding(vertical = 8.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceContainerHigh)
    ) {
        Canvas(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .height(if (enlarged) 440.dp else if (detailed) 270.dp else 190.dp)
                .semantics {
                    contentDescription =
                        diagram.caption + ". " + diagram.pins.joinToString { it.label }
                }
        ) {
            // A fixed design space keeps proportions stable across phone densities and
            // orientations.
            val factor = min(size.width / 600f, size.height / 320f)
            withTransform({
                translate((size.width - 600f * factor) / 2, (size.height - 320f * factor) / 2)
                scale(factor, factor, Offset.Zero)
            }) {
                hardware(kind, diagram)
            }
        }
        Text(
            diagram.caption,
            color = Color(0xFF263C46),
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(start = 16.dp, end = 16.dp, bottom = 16.dp),
        )
        if (!enlarged)
            TextButton(onClick = { expanded = true }) {
                Text(stringResource(R.string.enlarge_diagram))
            }
    }
    if (expanded)
        Dialog(
            onDismissRequest = { expanded = false },
            properties = DialogProperties(usePlatformDefaultWidth = false),
        ) {
            Column(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface).padding(12.dp)
            ) {
                TextButton(onClick = { expanded = false }) {
                    Text(stringResource(R.string.close_diagram))
                }
                Box(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                        .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                ) {
                    illustratedConnector(diagram, Modifier.width(820.dp), enlarged = true)
                }
            }
        }
    return true
}

/**
 * Renders hardware in a 600 by 320 coordinate system with bevels, contacts and restrained shadows.
 *
 * @param kind Recognised illustration family.
 * @param diagram Original dataset supplies labels; logical maps retain their logical status.
 * @return Unit. Invalid family keys produce no illustration; canvas errors propagate.
 */
private fun DrawScope.hardware(kind: String, diagram: Diagram) {
    val ink = Color(0xFF263746)
    val gold = Color(0xFFE8B64B)
    val steel =
        Brush.verticalGradient(
            listOf(com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.DrawingMetal, Color(0xFF8B9CA6), com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.DrawingMetal),
            65f,
            245f,
        )
    val plastic = Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF428BC4), Color(0xFF195383)), 100f, 230f)
    // Soft offset shadow separates the physical shell from the paper-like diagram surface.
    drawOval(Color(0xFF233D49).copy(alpha = .12f), Offset(90f, 262f), Size(420f, 20f))
    when (kind) {
        "dsub",
        "centronics" -> {
            drawRoundRect(steel, Offset(48f, 65f), Size(504f, 185f), CornerRadius(24f))
            drawRoundRect(
                ink,
                Offset(48f, 65f),
                Size(504f, 185f),
                CornerRadius(24f),
                style = Stroke(3f),
            )
            for (x in listOf(80f, 520f)) {
                drawCircle(ink, 17f, Offset(x, 158f))
                drawCircle(Color(0xFFF9FBFC), 12f, Offset(x, 158f))
            }
            val shape =
                Path().apply {
                    moveTo(112f, 92f)
                    lineTo(488f, 92f)
                    quadraticTo(510f, 92f, 501f, 124f)
                    lineTo(480f, 216f)
                    quadraticTo(478f, 231f, 460f, 231f)
                    lineTo(140f, 231f)
                    quadraticTo(122f, 231f, 120f, 216f)
                    lineTo(99f, 124f)
                    quadraticTo(90f, 92f, 112f, 92f)
                    close()
                }
            drawPath(shape, plastic)
            drawPath(shape, ink, style = Stroke(4f))
            val n = diagram.pins.size
            val rows = if (n == 15 && diagram.caption.contains("VGA")) 3 else 2
            // D-sub numbering is sequential by row. This is an explicit male mating-face view.
            var number = 1
            repeat(rows) { row ->
                val count = if (rows == 3) 5 else if (row == 0) (n + 1) / 2 else n / 2
                repeat(count) { col ->
                    val x = 135f + (col + .5f) * 330f / count
                    val y = 126f + row * (if (rows == 3) 39f else 65f)
                    if (kind == "centronics")
                        drawRoundRect(
                            gold,
                            Offset(x - 4f, y - 10f),
                            Size(8f, 20f),
                            CornerRadius(2f),
                        )
                    else {
                        drawCircle(ink, if (count > 10) 8f else 10f, Offset(x, y))
                        drawCircle(gold, if (count > 10) 4f else 5f, Offset(x - 1f, y - 1f))
                    }
                    hardwareLabel(
                        (number++).toString(),
                        x,
                        y - 16f,
                        ink,
                        if (count > 10) 13f else 17f,
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        "round" -> {
            drawCircle(steel, 112f, Offset(300f, 159f))
            drawCircle(ink, 112f, Offset(300f, 159f), style = Stroke(3f))
            drawCircle(Color(0xFF263C49), 92f, Offset(300f, 159f))
            drawCircle(Color(0xFF49616D), 83f, Offset(300f, 159f), style = Stroke(3f))
            drawRoundRect(com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.DrawingMetal, Offset(288f, 237f), Size(24f, 19f), CornerRadius(3f))
            // Unnumbered housing illustration: uncertain DIN/XLR mating-face numbering is not
            // invented.
            repeat(diagram.pins.size) { i ->
                val angle = (210.0 + i * 300.0 / maxOf(1, diagram.pins.size - 1)) * PI / 180
                val x = 300f + cos(angle).toFloat() * 58f
                val y = 159f + sin(angle).toFloat() * 58f
                drawCircle(gold, 10f, Offset(x, y))
                drawCircle(ink, 5f, Offset(x, y))
            }
        }
        "rca",
        "jack" -> {
            drawRoundRect(ink, Offset(35f, 140f), Size(145f, 40f), CornerRadius(12f))
            drawRoundRect(
                Brush.verticalGradient(
                    listOf(Color(0xFFED7A70), Color(0xFFC03836), Color(0xFF6F1D25)),
                    110f,
                    210f,
                ),
                Offset(150f, 105f),
                Size(210f, 110f),
                CornerRadius(15f),
            )
            repeat(7) { i ->
                drawLine(
                    Color(0xFF762632),
                    Offset(165f + i * 18f, 111f),
                    Offset(165f + i * 18f, 209f),
                    3f,
                )
            }
            drawRoundRect(
                steel,
                Offset(355f, 120f),
                Size(if (kind == "rca") 100f else 175f, 80f),
                CornerRadius(8f),
            )
            if (kind == "rca")
                drawRoundRect(gold, Offset(452f, 150f), Size(93f, 20f), CornerRadius(9f))
            else repeat(3) { i -> drawRect(ink, Offset(400f + i * 39f, 120f), Size(9f, 80f)) }
            // Numbered labels refer directly to the existing contact table, not assumed wire
            // colours.
            diagram.pins.forEachIndexed { i, pin ->
                hardwareLabel(
                    pin.label,
                    if (kind == "rca") (if (i == 0) 500f else 398f) else 375f + i * 46f,
                    96f,
                    ink,
                    19f,
                )
            }
        }
        "power",
        "modular" -> {
            drawRoundRect(steel, Offset(64f, 65f), Size(472f, 184f), CornerRadius(14f))
            drawRoundRect(ink, Offset(78f, 80f), Size(444f, 154f), CornerRadius(8f))
            drawRoundRect(Color(0xFF899CA2), Offset(260f, 49f), Size(80f, 22f), CornerRadius(4f))
            diagram.pins.forEachIndexed { i, pin ->
                val n = diagram.pins.size
                val rows =
                    if (kind == "power" && n != 4) 2
                    else if (diagram.caption.contains("ATX12V")) 2 else 1
                val cols = n / rows
                val x = 95f + (i % cols + .5f) * 410f / cols
                val y = if (rows == 1) 159f else 120f + (i / cols) * 77f
                drawRoundRect(
                    Color(0xFFCED7DA),
                    Offset(x - 12f, y - 12f),
                    Size(24f, 25f),
                    CornerRadius(3f),
                )
                drawRect(
                    if (kind == "modular") gold else ink,
                    Offset(x - 6f, y - 5f),
                    Size(12f, 12f),
                )
                if (kind == "modular") hardwareLabel(pin.label, x, y - 16f, Color.White, 15f)
            }
        }
        "regulator" -> {
            drawRoundRect(steel, Offset(230f, 30f), Size(140f, 115f), CornerRadius(12f))
            drawCircle(ink, 19f, Offset(300f, 65f))
            drawCircle(com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.DrawingMetal, 13f, Offset(300f, 65f))
            drawRoundRect(ink, Offset(215f, 100f), Size(170f, 118f), CornerRadius(10f))
            diagram.pins.forEachIndexed { i, pin ->
                val x = 250f + i * 50f
                drawRect(steel, Offset(x - 8f, 218f), Size(16f, 64f))
                hardwareLabel(pin.label, x, 307f, ink, 20f)
            }
        }
        "dip" -> {
            drawRoundRect(ink, Offset(115f, 96f), Size(370f, 130f), CornerRadius(15f))
            drawCircle(Color(0xFF657783), 13f, Offset(115f, 161f))
            drawCircle(Color(0xFFB8C8D0), 6f, Offset(139f, 205f))
            repeat(7) { i ->
                val x = 145f + i * 50f
                drawRect(steel, Offset(x - 8f, 67f), Size(16f, 29f))
                drawRect(steel, Offset(x - 8f, 226f), Size(16f, 29f))
                hardwareLabel((14 - i).toString(), x, 52f, ink)
                hardwareLabel((i + 1).toString(), x, 280f, ink)
            }
            hardwareLabel(diagram.caption.substringBefore(" •"), 300f, 164f, com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.DrawingMetal, 17f)
        }
        "board" -> {
            drawRoundRect(
                Brush.linearGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF148DA0), Color(0xFF086476))),
                Offset(126f, 24f),
                Size(348f, 268f),
                CornerRadius(12f),
            )
            // This is an original identification illustration, with logical labels alongside it.
            // Thin original trace routes suggest the PCB construction without claiming a copper
            // layout.
            repeat(14) { index ->
                val x = 227f + index * 16f
                val trace =
                    Path().apply {
                        moveTo(x, 57f)
                        lineTo(x, 81f + (index % 4) * 8f)
                        lineTo(258f + index * 10f, 124f + (index % 4) * 5f)
                        lineTo(258f + index * 10f, 154f)
                    }
                drawPath(trace, Color(0xFF76BBAE).copy(alpha = .55f), style = Stroke(1.4f))
            }
            repeat(9) { index ->
                val x = 285f + (index % 3) * 22f
                val y = 84f + (index / 3) * 17f
                drawRoundRect(Color(0xFFBDC9C7), Offset(x, y), Size(15f, 6f), CornerRadius(1f))
                drawRect(Color(0xFFB6A27D), Offset(x + 4f, y), Size(7f, 6f))
            }
            drawCircle(steel, 14f, Offset(187f, 80f))
            drawCircle(Color(0xFFAD5038), 9f, Offset(187f, 80f))
            drawLine(Color(0xFFBDE0D6), Offset(180f, 116f), Offset(204f, 116f), 2f)
            for (x in listOf(142f, 456f)) for (y in listOf(40f, 276f)) {
                drawCircle(gold, 9f, Offset(x, y))
                drawCircle(com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.DrawingMetal, 5f, Offset(x, y))
            }
            drawRoundRect(steel, Offset(94f, 70f), Size(76f, 70f), CornerRadius(4f))
            drawRoundRect(ink, Offset(105f, 200f), Size(68f, 49f), CornerRadius(7f))
            drawRoundRect(ink, Offset(247f, 164f), Size(159f, 46f), CornerRadius(4f))
            repeat(14) { i ->
                val x = 253f + i * 11f
                drawRect(steel, Offset(x, 155f), Size(5f, 9f))
                drawRect(steel, Offset(x, 210f), Size(5f, 9f))
            }
            repeat(14) { i ->
                val x = 221f + i * 16f
                drawRect(ink, Offset(x, 34f), Size(13f, 22f))
                drawCircle(gold, 3f, Offset(x + 6f, 45f))
                hardwareLabel((13 - i).toString(), x + 6f, 75f, Color.White, 11f)
            }
            repeat(6) { i ->
                val x = 350f + i * 16f
                drawRect(ink, Offset(x, 254f), Size(13f, 22f))
                drawCircle(gold, 3f, Offset(x + 6f, 265f))
                hardwareLabel("A$i", x + 6f, 245f, Color.White, 11f)
            }
            repeat(8) { i ->
                val x = 199f + i * 16f
                drawRect(ink, Offset(x, 254f), Size(13f, 22f))
                drawCircle(gold, 3f, Offset(x + 6f, 265f))
            }
            repeat(3) { i ->
                drawCircle(steel, 13f, Offset(195f + i * 29f, 220f))
                drawLine(ink, Offset(186f + i * 29f, 220f), Offset(204f + i * 29f, 220f), 2f)
            }
            drawRoundRect(steel, Offset(213f, 107f), Size(54f, 22f), CornerRadius(10f))
            drawCircle(Color(0xFFE4CF61), 5f, Offset(412f, 107f))
            drawCircle(Color(0xFF76D896), 5f, Offset(430f, 107f))
            hardwareLabel("ATmega328P", 326f, 192f, com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.DrawingMetal, 12f)
            hardwareLabel("16 MHz", 240f, 140f, Color(0xFFC8E3DC), 10f)
            hardwareLabel("UNO • R3", 365f, 137f, Color.White, 23f)
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Places a sharp vector label using the illustration's density-independent design coordinates.
 *
 * @param text Contact number or hardware identification.
 * @param x Horizontal centre in design coordinates.
 * @param y Baseline in design coordinates.
 * @param color Foreground chosen for its local physical surface.
 * @param fontSize Text size in design coordinates.
 * @return Unit; native canvas failures propagate to the caller.
 */
private fun DrawScope.hardwareLabel(
    text: String,
    x: Float,
    y: Float,
    color: Color,
    fontSize: Float = 18f,
) {
    drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(
        text,
        x,
        y,
        android.graphics.Paint(android.graphics.Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            this.color = color.toArgb()
            textSize = fontSize
            textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER
            typeface =
                android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    android.graphics.Typeface.SANS_SERIF,
                    android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD,
                )
        },
    )
}
````

## app/src/main/java/com/electrokit/app/ui/components/Drawings.kt

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.ui.components

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.border
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.nativeCanvas
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.*
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.electrokit.app.R
import com.electrokit.app.data.Diagram
import kotlin.math.*

/**
 * Band-index palette keeps digit, multiplier and tolerance colours identical in drawings and
 * selectors.
 */
val BandColours =
    listOf(
            0xFF151515,
            0xFF754123,
            0xFFE52D27,
            0xFFF57C00,
            0xFFFFEB3B,
            0xFF18943B,
            0xFF245BCD,
            0xFF8B36A5,
            0xFF999999,
            0xFFF5F5F5,
            0xFFD4AF37,
            0xFFC0C0C0,
        )
        .map { Color(it) }

/**
 * Draws the original brand/reference motif while allowing decorative callers to suppress redundant
 * semantics.
 *
 * @param key Stable data key rather than a translated label.
 * @param modifier Caller-owned layout and semantics constraints.
 * @param description Optional original module summary, or icon accessibility text at the drawing
 *   entry point.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun EntryIcon(key: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null) {
    Canvas(modifier.size(36.dp).semantics { description?.let { contentDescription = it } }) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val index = key.drop(1).toIntOrNull() ?: 1
        val col = Color.hsv((index * 137.5f) % 360, 0.43f, 0.95f)
        /**
         * Shares stroke styling between connected schematic segments so visual joins stay
         * consistent.
         *
         * @param a First endpoint or branch scalar in the enclosing drawing/equation.
         * @param b Second endpoint or branch scalar in the enclosing drawing/equation.
         * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
         *   observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence
         *   failures belong to the ViewModel.
         */
        fun line(a: Offset, b: Offset) = drawLine(col, a, b, 2.dp.toPx(), StrokeCap.Round)
        // Each key has its own circuit path and contact pattern, drawn as vectors.
        if (key.startsWith("c")) {
            line(Offset(0f, h / 2), Offset(w * .22f, h / 2))
            line(Offset(w * .78f, h / 2), Offset(w, h / 2))
            drawRoundRect(
                col,
                Offset(w * .22f, h * .28f),
                Size(w * .56f, h * .44f),
                CornerRadius(3f),
                style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()),
            )
            repeat(1 + index % 4) { j ->
                drawLine(
                    col,
                    Offset(w * (.3f + j * .13f), h * .3f),
                    Offset(w * (.3f + j * .13f), h * .7f),
                    1.dp.toPx(),
                )
            }
        } else {
            drawRoundRect(
                col,
                Offset(w * .1f, h * .18f),
                Size(w * .8f, h * .64f),
                CornerRadius(if (key.startsWith("p")) 7f else 2f),
                style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()),
            )
            repeat(2 + index % 5) { j ->
                val x = w * (.2f + j * (.6f / (1 + index % 5)))
                drawCircle(col, 2.dp.toPx(), Offset(x, h * .5f))
            }
        }
        drawCircle(col, 2.dp.toPx(), Offset(w * .12f, h * (.07f + (index % 4) * .03f)))
    }
}

/**
 * Updates colour bands on an original resistor or coil drawing from the current input state.
 *
 * @param bands Current colour indices in drawing order.
 * @param inductor True draws a coil whose encoded value is in microhenries.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun ResistorDrawing(bands: List<Int>, inductor: Boolean = false) {
    val unknown = stringResource(R.string.unknown_colour)
    val componentName = stringResource(if (inductor) R.string.inductor else R.string.resistor)
    val description =
        stringResource(
            R.string.bands_accessibility,
            componentName,
            bands.joinToString {
                com.electrokit.app.domain.Resistors.names.getOrElse(it) { unknown }
            },
        )
    Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(150.dp).semantics { contentDescription = description }) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val y = h / 2
        drawLine(
            Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color.DarkGray, Color.LightGray, Color.Gray)),
            Offset(w * .08f, y),
            Offset(w * .92f, y),
            12.dp.toPx(),
        )
        if (inductor) {
            val path = Path()
            path.moveTo(w * .22f, y)
            for (i in 0..240) {
                val t = i / 240f
                path.lineTo(w * (.22f + .56f * t), y + sin(t * 8 * PI).toFloat() * h * .2f)
            }
            drawPath(path, Color(0xFFBCA75C), style = Stroke(9.dp.toPx()))
        } else {
            val path =
                Path().apply {
                    moveTo(w * .22f, y)
                    cubicTo(w * .18f, h * .05f, w * .32f, h * .08f, w * .38f, h * .3f)
                    lineTo(w * .62f, h * .3f)
                    cubicTo(w * .68f, h * .08f, w * .82f, h * .05f, w * .78f, y)
                    cubicTo(w * .82f, h * .95f, w * .68f, h * .92f, w * .62f, h * .7f)
                    lineTo(w * .38f, h * .7f)
                    cubicTo(w * .32f, h * .92f, w * .18f, h * .95f, w * .22f, y)
                    close()
                }
            drawPath(
                path,
                Brush.verticalGradient(
                    listOf(Color(0xFF9C9273), Color(0xFFE8DFBA), Color(0xFFB4A784))
                ),
            )
        }
        bands.forEachIndexed { i, c ->
            val x = w * (.37f + i * (.27f / (bands.size - 1)))
            drawRect(BandColours[c], Offset(x, h * .3f), Size(w * .025f, h * .4f))
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Draws normalised response samples in a bounded chart and avoids scaling from an empty sample set.
 *
 * @param points Normalised samples ordered along the horizontal axis.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun ResponsePlot(points: List<Double>) {
    val description = stringResource(R.string.response_accessibility)
    if (points.isEmpty()) return
    Canvas(
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(145.dp).padding(12.dp).semantics {
            contentDescription = description
        }
    ) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        repeat(5) { i ->
            drawLine(Color.Gray.copy(alpha = .3f), Offset(0f, h * i / 4), Offset(w, h * i / 4), 1f)
        }
        val p = Path()
        points.forEachIndexed { i, y ->
            val x = i * w / (points.size - 1)
            val py = h * (1 - y.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0).toFloat())
            if (i == 0) p.moveTo(x, py) else p.lineTo(x, py)
        }
        drawPath(p, Color(0xFF8BC34A), style = Stroke(3.dp.toPx()))
    }
}

/**
 * Renders JSON identification geometry; contact labels do not certify a mechanical footprint or
 * mating view.
 *
 * @param diagram Decoded shape, caption and contact geometry.
 * @param modifier Caller-owned layout and semantics constraints.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun DiagramView(diagram: Diagram, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    if (illustratedConnector(diagram, modifier)) return
    val nodeTemplate = stringResource(R.string.node_label)
    val fg = Color(0xFFE1EAF0)
    Column(
        modifier
            .padding(vertical = 8.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
            .background(Color(0xFF14252D))
            .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF35505B), RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
    ) {
        Canvas(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .height(
                    if (
                        diagram.shape == "usbA" ||
                            diagram.shape.contains("Mini") ||
                            diagram.shape.contains("Micro")
                    )
                        100.dp
                    else
                        maxOf(170, diagram.pins.map { it.y }.distinct().size * 32 + 32)
                            .coerceAtMost(1000)
                            .dp
                )
                .padding(12.dp)
                .semantics {
                    contentDescription =
                        diagram.caption + ". " + diagram.pins.joinToString { it.label }
                }
        ) {
            val w = size.width
            val h = size.height
            for (x in 0..(w / 24.dp.toPx()).toInt()) drawLine(
                Color(0xFF25404A).copy(alpha = .45f),
                Offset(x * 24.dp.toPx(), 0f),
                Offset(x * 24.dp.toPx(), h),
                1f,
            )
            for (y in 0..(h / 24.dp.toPx()).toInt()) drawLine(
                Color(0xFF25404A).copy(alpha = .45f),
                Offset(0f, y * 24.dp.toPx()),
                Offset(w, y * 24.dp.toPx()),
                1f,
            )
            /**
             * Shares stroke styling between connected schematic segments so visual joins stay
             * consistent.
             *
             * @param a First endpoint or branch scalar in the enclosing drawing/equation.
             * @param b Second endpoint or branch scalar in the enclosing drawing/equation.
             * @param width Canvas stroke width used to keep schematic connections visually
             *   consistent.
             * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
             *   observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence
             *   failures belong to the ViewModel.
             */
            fun line(a: Offset, b: Offset, width: Float = 3f) = drawLine(fg, a, b, width)
            /**
             * Places vector annotations in the drawing coordinate system with explicit foreground
             * sizing.
             *
             * @param text Input or output text as described above; treated as data, never executed.
             * @param x Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
             * @param y Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
             * @param color Annotation foreground chosen for contrast against the technical drawing
             *   panel.
             * @param sz Base annotation text size converted using display density.
             * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
             *   observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence
             *   failures belong to the ViewModel.
             */
            fun label(text: String, x: Float, y: Float, color: Color = fg, sz: Float = 14f) {
                drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(
                    text,
                    x,
                    y,
                    android.graphics.Paint(android.graphics.Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
                        this.color = color.toArgb()
                        textSize = sz * density
                        textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER
                    },
                )
            }
            if (diagram.shape == "bus") {
                for (j in 0..1) drawLine(
                    if (j == 0) Color(0xFFE0C840) else Color(0xFF5FC4E0),
                    Offset(w * .08f, h * (.35f + j * .16f)),
                    Offset(w * .92f, h * (.35f + j * .16f)),
                    3f,
                )
                repeat(3) { i ->
                    val x = w * (.2f + i * .3f)
                    val xa = x - w * .018f
                    val xb = x + w * .018f
                    line(Offset(xa, h * .35f), Offset(xa, h * .7f))
                    line(Offset(xb, h * .51f), Offset(xb, h * .7f))
                    drawCircle(Color(0xFFE0C840), 3 * density, Offset(xa, h * .35f))
                    drawCircle(Color(0xFF5FC4E0), 3 * density, Offset(xb, h * .51f))
                    drawRect(
                        fg,
                        Offset(x - w * .085f, h * .7f),
                        Size(w * .17f, h * .17f),
                        style = Stroke(2f),
                    )
                    label(
                        nodeTemplate.format(java.util.Locale.getDefault(), i + 1),
                        x,
                        h * .98f,
                        sz = 11f,
                    )
                }
                for (x in listOf(w * .08f, w * .92f)) {
                    line(Offset(x, h * .35f), Offset(x, h * .39f))
                    drawRect(
                        fg,
                        Offset(x - 3 * density, h * .39f),
                        Size(6 * density, h * .08f),
                        style = Stroke(2f),
                    )
                    line(Offset(x, h * .47f), Offset(x, h * .51f))
                    label("Rₜ", x, h * .2f)
                }
            } else if (diagram.shape.startsWith("switch:")) {
                val type = diagram.shape.substringAfter(':')
                /**
                 * Distinguishes an electrical contact from the connector outline.
                 *
                 * @param x Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
                 * @param y Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
                 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks
                 *   or observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable
                 *   persistence failures belong to the ViewModel.
                 */
                fun contact(x: Float, y: Float) {
                    drawCircle(fg, 4 * density, Offset(w * x, h * y), style = Stroke(2f))
                }
                /**
                 * Draws a schematic connection between the supplied normalised endpoints.
                 *
                 * @param x1 Normalised horizontal start coordinate, scaled by this canvas width.
                 * @param y1 Normalised vertical start coordinate, scaled by this canvas height.
                 * @param x2 Normalised horizontal end coordinate, scaled by this canvas width.
                 * @param y2 Normalised vertical end coordinate, scaled by this canvas height.
                 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks
                 *   or observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable
                 *   persistence failures belong to the ViewModel.
                 */
                fun segment(x1: Float, y1: Float, x2: Float, y2: Float) =
                    line(Offset(w * x1, h * y1), Offset(w * x2, h * y2))
                /**
                 * Reuses switch-pole geometry for the alternative-contact diagrams.
                 *
                 * @param y Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
                 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks
                 *   or observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable
                 *   persistence failures belong to the ViewModel.
                 */
                fun changeover(y: Float) {
                    contact(.3f, y)
                    contact(.7f, y - .13f)
                    contact(.7f, y + .13f)
                    segment(.08f, y, .3f, y)
                    segment(.3f, y, .66f, y - .13f)
                    segment(.7f, y - .13f, .92f, y - .13f)
                    segment(.7f, y + .13f, .92f, y + .13f)
                }
                when (type) {
                    "SPDT" -> changeover(.5f)
                    "DPDT" -> {
                        changeover(.28f)
                        changeover(.72f)
                        drawLine(
                            fg,
                            Offset(w * .48f, h * .2f),
                            Offset(w * .48f, h * .64f),
                            2f,
                            pathEffect = PathEffect.dashPathEffect(floatArrayOf(6f, 6f)),
                        )
                    }
                    "Rotary" -> {
                        contact(.4f, .5f)
                        segment(.1f, .5f, .4f, .5f)
                        repeat(5) { i ->
                            val angle = (-70 + i * 35) * PI / 180
                            val x = .4f + .32f * cos(angle).toFloat()
                            val y = .5f + .4f * sin(angle).toFloat()
                            contact(x, y)
                        }
                        segment(.4f, .5f, .7f, .5f)
                    }
                    "PushNO",
                    "PushNC" -> {
                        contact(.3f, .6f)
                        contact(.7f, .6f)
                        segment(.1f, .6f, .3f, .6f)
                        segment(.7f, .6f, .9f, .6f)
                        val yy = if (type == "PushNC") .6f else .4f
                        segment(.25f, yy, .75f, yy)
                        segment(.5f, .12f, .5f, yy)
                        segment(.38f, .12f, .62f, .12f)
                    }
                    else -> {
                        contact(.3f, .6f)
                        contact(.7f, .6f)
                        segment(.1f, .6f, .3f, .6f)
                        segment(.7f, .6f, .9f, .6f)
                        segment(.3f, .6f, .68f, .3f)
                    }
                }
            } else if (diagram.shape.startsWith("symbol:") || diagram.shape.startsWith("logic:")) {
                val s = diagram.shape.substringAfter(':')
                val a = w * .3f
                val b = w * .7f
                val y = h * .5f
                line(Offset(w * .1f, y), Offset(a, y))
                line(Offset(b, y), Offset(w * .9f, y))
                when (s) {
                    "capacitor" -> {
                        line(Offset(w * .47f, h * .25f), Offset(w * .47f, h * .75f))
                        line(Offset(w * .53f, h * .25f), Offset(w * .53f, h * .75f))
                        line(Offset(a, y), Offset(w * .47f, y))
                        line(Offset(w * .53f, y), Offset(b, y))
                    }
                    "ground" -> {
                        line(Offset(w * .5f, h * .2f), Offset(w * .5f, y))
                        repeat(3) { i ->
                            val d = w * (.18f - i * .05f)
                            line(
                                Offset(w / 2 - d, y + i * h * .1f),
                                Offset(w / 2 + d, y + i * h * .1f),
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    "switch" -> {
                        drawCircle(fg, 5f, Offset(a, y))
                        drawCircle(fg, 5f, Offset(b, y))
                        line(Offset(a, y), Offset(b, h * .25f))
                    }
                    "op_amp" -> {
                        val p =
                            Path().apply {
                                moveTo(a, h * .15f)
                                lineTo(b, y)
                                lineTo(a, h * .85f)
                                close()
                            }
                        drawPath(p, fg, style = Stroke(3f))
                        label("+", a + w * .05f, h * .38f)
                        label("−", a + w * .05f, h * .7f)
                    }
                    "inductor" -> {
                        val p = Path()
                        for (i in 0..100) {
                            val t = i / 100f
                            val x = a + (b - a) * t
                            val yy = y - sin(t * 4 * PI).toFloat() * h * .18f
                            if (i == 0) p.moveTo(x, yy) else p.lineTo(x, yy)
                        }
                        drawPath(p, fg, style = Stroke(3f))
                    }
                    "diode",
                    "LED" -> {
                        val p =
                            Path().apply {
                                moveTo(a, h * .25f)
                                lineTo(b, y)
                                lineTo(a, h * .75f)
                                close()
                            }
                        drawPath(p, fg, style = Stroke(3f))
                        line(Offset(b, h * .25f), Offset(b, h * .75f))
                        if (s == "LED") {
                            line(Offset(w * .6f, h * .2f), Offset(w * .7f, h * .08f))
                            label("↗", w * .75f, h * .2f)
                        }
                    }
                    "battery" -> {
                        line(Offset(w * .45f, h * .15f), Offset(w * .45f, h * .85f))
                        line(Offset(w * .55f, h * .3f), Offset(w * .55f, h * .7f))
                        line(Offset(a, y), Offset(w * .45f, y))
                        line(Offset(w * .55f, y), Offset(b, y))
                        label("+", w * .4f, h * .15f)
                    }
                    "voltage_source",
                    "current_source" -> {
                        drawCircle(fg, h * .3f, Offset(w / 2, y), style = Stroke(3f))
                        label(if (s == "voltage_source") "+ / −" else "↑", w / 2, y + 5 * density)
                    }
                    else -> {
                        drawRoundRect(
                            fg,
                            Offset(a, h * .2f),
                            Size(b - a, h * .6f),
                            CornerRadius(if (diagram.shape.startsWith("logic:")) h * .1f else 0f),
                            style = Stroke(3f),
                        )
                        label(
                            when (s) {
                                "AND",
                                "NAND" -> "&"
                                "OR",
                                "NOR" -> "≥1"
                                "XOR",
                                "XNOR" -> "=1"
                                "NOT" -> "1"
                                "resistor" -> "R"
                                "fuse" -> "F"
                                else -> s
                            },
                            w / 2,
                            y + 6 * density,
                        )
                        if (s in listOf("NAND", "NOR", "XNOR", "NOT"))
                            drawCircle(
                                fg,
                                6 * density,
                                Offset(b + 6 * density, y),
                                style = Stroke(2f),
                            )
                    }
                }
            } else if (diagram.shape.startsWith("usb")) {
                val kind = diagram.shape
                val bw = if (kind == "usbB") minOf(w * .88f, h * .7f) else w * .88f
                val x = (w - bw) / 2
                val y = h * .12f
                val bh = h * .7f
                val shell = Color(0xFFDDDCD5)
                val inner = Color(0xFF858585)
                val bevel = kind.contains("B") || kind.contains("Mini") || kind.contains("Micro")
                val outer =
                    Path().apply {
                        if (kind == "usbB") {
                            moveTo(x + bw * .18f, y)
                            lineTo(x + bw * .82f, y)
                            lineTo(x + bw, y + bh * .18f)
                            lineTo(x + bw, y + bh)
                            lineTo(x, y + bh)
                            lineTo(x, y + bh * .18f)
                            close()
                        } else {
                            moveTo(x + bw * .1f, y)
                            lineTo(x + bw * .9f, y)
                            lineTo(x + bw, y + bh * .2f)
                            lineTo(x + bw * .94f, y + bh * .78f)
                            lineTo(x + bw * .8f, y + bh)
                            lineTo(x + bw * .2f, y + bh)
                            lineTo(x + bw * .06f, y + bh * .78f)
                            lineTo(x, y + bh * .2f)
                            close()
                        }
                    }
                if (bevel)
                    drawPath(
                        outer,
                        Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color.White, shell, Color(0xFF8A979D))),
                    )
                else
                    drawRoundRect(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color.White, shell, Color(0xFF8A979D))),
                        Offset(x, y),
                        Size(bw, bh),
                        CornerRadius(if (kind.contains("C")) bh / 2 else 14f),
                    )
                drawRoundRect(
                    Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF35434A), inner)),
                    Offset(x + bw * .1f, y + bh * .15f),
                    Size(bw * .8f, bh * .7f),
                    CornerRadius(6f),
                )
                drawRoundRect(
                    if (kind.contains("3")) Color(0xFF0685BB) else Color(0xFFC0C0BA),
                    Offset(x + bw * .17f, y + bh * .25f),
                    Size(bw * .66f, bh * .5f),
                    CornerRadius(3f),
                )
                diagram.pins.forEach { pin ->
                    val px = x + bw * pin.x
                    val py = y + bh * pin.y
                    drawRect(
                        Color(0xFFFFD342),
                        Offset(px - 3 * density, py),
                        Size(6 * density, 4 * density),
                    )
                    val tagWidth = maxOf(18f, pin.label.length * 8f) * density
                    drawRoundRect(
                        Color(0xFF14252D),
                        Offset(px - tagWidth / 2, py - 20 * density),
                        Size(tagWidth, 17 * density),
                        CornerRadius(3 * density),
                    )
                    label(
                        pin.label,
                        px,
                        py - 4 * density,
                        Color(0xFFFFE082),
                        if (diagram.pins.size > 12) 8f else 12f,
                    )
                }
            } else {
                val x = w * .04f
                val y = h * .05f
                val rw = w * .92f
                val rh = h * .9f
                if (diagram.shape == "round")
                    drawOval(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFFCAD6DD), Color(0xFF526A78))),
                        Offset(x, y),
                        Size(rw, rh),
                    )
                else if (diagram.shape == "bevel") {
                    val path =
                        Path().apply {
                            moveTo(x + rw * .08f, y)
                            lineTo(x + rw * .92f, y)
                            lineTo(x + rw, y + rh * .25f)
                            lineTo(x + rw * .88f, y + rh)
                            lineTo(x + rw * .12f, y + rh)
                            lineTo(x, y + rh * .25f)
                            close()
                        }
                    drawPath(
                        path,
                        Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF839EAC), Color(0xFF344F5D))),
                    )
                } else
                    drawRoundRect(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF407C70), Color(0xFF224F4E))),
                        Offset(x, y),
                        Size(rw, rh),
                        CornerRadius(12f),
                        style = Fill,
                    )
                diagram.pins.forEach { pin ->
                    val px = x + rw * pin.x
                    val py = y + rh * pin.y
                    drawRoundRect(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFFFFE6A4), Color(0xFFBA852D))),
                        Offset(px - 4 * density, py),
                        Size(8 * density, 11 * density),
                        CornerRadius(1f),
                    )
                    label(
                        pin.label,
                        px,
                        py - 3 * density,
                        Color(0xFFFFD54F),
                        if (diagram.pins.size > 20) 10f else 14f,
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        Text(
            diagram.caption,
            color = Color(0xFFB5D2DF),
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 14.dp),
        )
    }
}
````

````kotlin
@file:OptIn(androidx.compose.foundation.layout.ExperimentalLayoutApi::class)

package com.electrokit.app.ui.components

import androidx.compose.foundation.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.gestures.detectTapGestures
import androidx.compose.foundation.gestures.detectTransformGestures
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.rememberSaveable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.nativeCanvas
import androidx.compose.ui.input.pointer.pointerInput
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.*
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.window.Dialog
import androidx.compose.ui.window.DialogProperties
import com.electrokit.app.R
import com.electrokit.app.data.*
import kotlin.math.*

/**
 * Presents an original educational escalator side cutaway with actual selectable reference routes.
 *
 * @param data Technical records and explicitly approximate source-backed marker positions.
 * @param navigate Opens the selected component; no machine-control action is provided.
 * @return Unit. Legend buttons expose every marker to accessibility services; drawing failure
 *   propagates.
 */
@Composable
fun EscalatorCutaway(data: EngineeringContent, navigate: (String) -> Unit) {
    var enlarged by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Column(Modifier.padding(12.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Text(
                stringResource(R.string.engine_cutaway),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
            )
            CutawayCanvas(data, false, navigate)
            Text(
                stringResource(R.string.engine_drawing_notice),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
            )
            TextButton({ enlarged = true }) { Text(stringResource(R.string.engine_enlarge)) }
            Row(
                Modifier.horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
            ) {
                data.markers.forEachIndexed { index, marker ->
                    val title = data.records.firstOrNull { it.id == marker.record }?.title.orEmpty()
                    OutlinedButton({ navigate("record:" + marker.record) }) {
                        Text("${index + 1} · " + title.substringBefore(" — "))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (enlarged)
        Dialog(
            onDismissRequest = { enlarged = false },
            properties = DialogProperties(usePlatformDefaultWidth = false),
        ) {
            Column(
                Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                    .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)
                    .padding(12.dp)
            ) {
                TextButton({ enlarged = false }) { Text(stringResource(R.string.engine_close)) }
                Text(
                    stringResource(R.string.engine_drawing_notice),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                )
                CutawayCanvas(data, true, navigate)
            }
        }
}

/**
 * Converts taps and pinch/pan gestures back into the exact common drawing coordinate space.
 *
 * @param data Validated approximate marker metadata.
 * @param interactive True enables zoom/pan inside the inspection dialog, leaving list scrolling
 *   alone.
 * @param navigate Receives the selected record route.
 * @return Unit; scale/pan are bounded, and taps outside markers do nothing.
 */
@Composable
private fun CutawayCanvas(
    data: EngineeringContent,
    interactive: Boolean,
    navigate: (String) -> Unit,
) {
    var zoom by rememberSaveable { mutableFloatStateOf(1f) }
    var pan by remember { mutableStateOf(Offset.Zero) }
    val description = stringResource(R.string.engine_cutaway)
    val markerDescription = stringResource(R.string.engine_marker, data.markers.size.toString())
    Column {
        if (interactive)
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                OutlinedButton({ zoom = (zoom * 1.3f).coerceAtMost(4f) }) {
                    Text(stringResource(R.string.engine_zoom_in))
                }
                OutlinedButton({ zoom = (zoom / 1.3f).coerceAtLeast(1f) }) {
                    Text(stringResource(R.string.engine_zoom_out))
                }
                TextButton({
                    zoom = 1f
                    pan = Offset.Zero
                }) {
                    Text(stringResource(R.string.engine_reset_view))
                }
            }
        Canvas(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .height(if (interactive) 480.dp else 260.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceContainerHigh)
                .semantics { contentDescription = "$description. $markerDescription" }
                .then(
                    if (interactive)
                        Modifier.pointerInput(Unit) {
                            detectTransformGestures { _, change, scale, _ ->
                                zoom = (zoom * scale).coerceIn(1f, 4f)
                                pan =
                                    if (zoom == 1f) Offset.Zero
                                    else
                                        Offset(
                                            (pan.x + change.x).coerceIn(
                                                -size.width * (zoom - 1f),
                                                size.width * (zoom - 1f),
                                            ),
                                            (pan.y + change.y).coerceIn(
                                                -size.height * (zoom - 1f),
                                                size.height * (zoom - 1f),
                                            ),
                                        )
                            }
                        }
                    else Modifier
                )
                .pointerInput(data.markers, zoom, pan) {
                    detectTapGestures { tap ->
                        val base = min(size.width / 1000f, size.height / 560f)
                        val origin =
                            Offset(
                                (size.width - 1000f * base) / 2,
                                (size.height - 560f * base) / 2,
                            ) + pan
                        val point = (tap - origin) / (base * zoom)
                        data.markers
                            .minByOrNull { hypot(point.x - it.x, point.y - it.y) }
                            ?.takeIf { hypot(point.x - it.x, point.y - it.y) < 38f }
                            ?.let { navigate("record:" + it.record) }
                    }
                }
        ) {
            val base = min(size.width / 1000f, size.height / 560f)
            withTransform({
                translate(
                    (size.width - 1000f * base) / 2 + pan.x,
                    (size.height - 560f * base) / 2 + pan.y,
                )
                scale(base * zoom, base * zoom, Offset.Zero)
            }) {
                escalatorStructure()
                data.markers.forEachIndexed { index, marker ->
                    drawCircle(Color(0xFF164E40), 25f, Offset(marker.x, marker.y))
                    drawCircle(
                        Color(0xFFCAEDD9),
                        25f,
                        Offset(marker.x, marker.y),
                        style = Stroke(3f),
                    )
                    industrialLabel(
                        (index + 1).toString(),
                        marker.x,
                        marker.y + 8f,
                        Color.White,
                        23f,
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Builds a 1000×560 side-view cutaway without asserting construction dimensions or exact mounting.
 *
 * @return Unit; all proportions are illustrative and canvas failures propagate.
 */
private fun DrawScope.escalatorStructure() {
    val ink = Color(0xFF2D4A56)
    val steel =
        Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFFB9CDD5), Color(0xFF6C8E9C), com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.DrawingMetal))
    val truss =
        Path().apply {
            moveTo(80f, 420f)
            lineTo(230f, 420f)
            lineTo(750f, 180f)
            lineTo(930f, 180f)
            lineTo(930f, 295f)
            lineTo(790f, 295f)
            lineTo(270f, 530f)
            lineTo(80f, 530f)
            close()
        }
    drawPath(truss, steel)
    drawPath(truss, ink, style = Stroke(5f))
    // Truss bracing and the return path remain visible through the simplified cutaway.
    repeat(10) { i ->
        val x = 240f + i * 52f
        val y = 420f - i * 24f
        drawLine(ink.copy(alpha = .5f), Offset(x, y + 8f), Offset(x + 52f, y + 87f), 4f)
        drawLine(ink.copy(alpha = .5f), Offset(x, y + 110f), Offset(x + 52f, y - 17f), 4f)
    }
    val glass =
        Path().apply {
            moveTo(95f, 350f)
            lineTo(225f, 350f)
            lineTo(750f, 106f)
            lineTo(922f, 106f)
            lineTo(922f, 176f)
            lineTo(755f, 176f)
            lineTo(230f, 417f)
            lineTo(95f, 417f)
            close()
        }
    drawPath(
        glass,
        Brush.verticalGradient(
            listOf(Color(0xFF9BD9E0).copy(alpha = .65f), com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.DrawingMetal.copy(alpha = .7f))
        ),
    )
    drawPath(glass, Color(0xFF4A929E), style = Stroke(3f))
    val rail =
        Path().apply {
            moveTo(100f, 420f)
            cubicTo(25f, 415f, 25f, 345f, 100f, 340f)
            lineTo(225f, 340f)
            lineTo(750f, 96f)
            lineTo(915f, 96f)
            cubicTo(995f, 96f, 995f, 175f, 920f, 178f)
            lineTo(760f, 178f)
            lineTo(230f, 422f)
            close()
        }
    drawPath(rail, Color(0xFF223C45), style = Stroke(12f, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
    drawPath(rail, Color(0xFF5C7C83), style = Stroke(3f))
    // Stair treads transition between horizontal landings and the inclined run.
    repeat(25) { i ->
        val x = 225f + i * 21f
        val y = 419f - i * 9.7f
        drawRect(ink, Offset(x, y), Size(23f, 13f))
        drawLine(Color(0xFFF1D77F), Offset(x, y), Offset(x + 23f, y), 3f)
        repeat(4) { groove ->
            drawLine(
                Color(0xFF8EA7AE),
                Offset(x + 3 + groove * 5, y + 3),
                Offset(x + 3 + groove * 5, y + 10),
                1f,
            )
        }
    }
    for (x in listOf(140f, 850f)) {
        val y = if (x < 500) 480f else 245f
        drawCircle(ink, 37f, Offset(x, y))
        drawCircle(Color(0xFFC8D9DC), 28f, Offset(x, y))
        drawCircle(ink, 9f, Offset(x, y))
        repeat(8) { j ->
            val a = j * PI / 4
            drawLine(
                ink,
                Offset(x, y),
                Offset(x + cos(a).toFloat() * 27, y + sin(a).toFloat() * 27),
                3f,
            )
        }
    }
    drawLine(Color(0xFFD4AD4E), Offset(140f, 480f), Offset(850f, 245f), 6f)
    drawLine(Color(0xFF506E79), Offset(155f, 503f), Offset(860f, 267f), 5f)
    drawRoundRect(Color(0xFF477DA3), Offset(760f, 190f), Size(58f, 40f), CornerRadius(5f))
    repeat(7) { i ->
        drawLine(Color(0xFFA4C4D2), Offset(766f + i * 7, 193f), Offset(766f + i * 7, 226f), 2f)
    }
    drawRoundRect(Color(0xFF8CA6AC), Offset(825f, 198f), Size(40f, 35f), CornerRadius(5f))
    drawRect(Color(0xFF395860), Offset(885f, 195f), Size(35f, 62f))
    drawRect(Color(0xFFD2BE74), Offset(155f, 412f), Size(65f, 7f))
    drawRect(Color(0xFFD2BE74), Offset(752f, 181f), Size(65f, 7f))
}

/**
 * Draws recognisable motor, brake, controller, sensor and panel component identification artwork.
 *
 * @param kind Original renderer family; no manufacturer's construction details are implied.
 * @param label Source identifier drawn on the illustration.
 * @return Unit; the visible caption distinguishes artwork from approved wiring/layout data.
 */
@Composable
fun IndustrialFigure(kind: String, label: String) {
    val notice = stringResource(R.string.engine_illustrative)
    Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Canvas(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(220.dp).semantics {
                contentDescription = "$label. $notice"
            }
        ) {
            val factor = min(size.width / 600f, size.height / 300f)
            withTransform({
                translate((size.width - 600f * factor) / 2, (size.height - 300f * factor) / 2)
                scale(factor, factor, Offset.Zero)
            }) {
                industrialBody(kind, label)
            }
        }
        Text(notice, Modifier.padding(12.dp), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
    }
}

/**
 * Uses a shared 600×300 design space for consistent, original equipment illustrations.
 *
 * @param kind Component renderer family; unknown kinds use the generic labelled electronics
 *   enclosure.
 * @param label Identifier rather than an invented rating or terminal assignment.
 * @return Unit; all geometry is illustrative and drawing errors propagate.
 */
private fun DrawScope.industrialBody(kind: String, label: String) {
    val ink = Color(0xFF213C4A)
    val metal =
        Brush.verticalGradient(
            listOf(com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.DrawingMetal, Color(0xFF8DA4B1), com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.DrawingMetal),
            50f,
            245f,
        )
    drawOval(ink.copy(alpha = .15f), Offset(110f, 252f), Size(380f, 20f))
    when (kind) {
        "motor" -> {
            drawRoundRect(ink, Offset(165f, 235f), Size(260f, 20f), CornerRadius(4f))
            drawRoundRect(
                Brush.verticalGradient(
                    listOf(Color(0xFF6CA8C5), Color(0xFF236B97), Color(0xFF163F61))
                ),
                Offset(175f, 88f),
                Size(235f, 140f),
                CornerRadius(22f),
            )
            repeat(17) { i ->
                drawLine(
                    Color(0xFFAFD2DF).copy(alpha = .65f),
                    Offset(193f + i * 12, 96f),
                    Offset(193f + i * 12, 218f),
                    3f,
                )
            }
            drawOval(metal, Offset(145f, 90f), Size(70f, 136f))
            drawOval(ink, Offset(159f, 115f), Size(40f, 86f))
            drawRoundRect(metal, Offset(76f, 145f), Size(105f, 25f), CornerRadius(4f))
            drawRoundRect(metal, Offset(244f, 53f), Size(95f, 39f), CornerRadius(6f))
            repeat(5) { i ->
                drawLine(ink, Offset(418f, 111f + i * 22), Offset(438f, 122f + i * 18), 5f)
            }
            drawRoundRect(Color(0xFFD6E1DD), Offset(258f, 132f), Size(113f, 43f), CornerRadius(4f))
            industrialLabel(label, 314f, 158f, ink, 17f)
        }
        "brake" -> {
            drawRoundRect(metal, Offset(105f, 140f), Size(390f, 25f), CornerRadius(7f))
            drawCircle(metal, 91f, Offset(300f, 150f))
            drawCircle(ink, 91f, Offset(300f, 150f), style = Stroke(4f))
            drawCircle(Color(0xFF506F7A), 34f, Offset(300f, 150f))
            repeat(8) { i ->
                val a = i * PI / 4
                drawCircle(
                    ink,
                    5f,
                    Offset(300f + cos(a).toFloat() * 66, 150f + sin(a).toFloat() * 66),
                )
            }
            for (x in listOf(191f, 359f)) {
                drawRoundRect(ink, Offset(x, 86f), Size(50f, 126f), CornerRadius(8f))
                drawRect(Color(0xFFBB7752), Offset(if (x < 300) x + 41 else x, 99f), Size(9f, 101f))
            }
            industrialLabel(label, 300f, 277f, ink, 20f)
        }
        "sensor" -> {
            drawRoundRect(ink, Offset(83f, 147f), Size(105f, 22f), CornerRadius(9f))
            drawRoundRect(metal, Offset(175f, 115f), Size(240f, 88f), CornerRadius(17f))
            repeat(19) { i ->
                drawLine(
                    Color(0xFF657F8A),
                    Offset(190f + i * 11, 120f),
                    Offset(190f + i * 11, 197f),
                    2f,
                )
            }
            drawOval(Color(0xFFDAA54C), Offset(382f, 116f), Size(48f, 86f))
            drawCircle(Color(0xFF77D3A9), 7f, Offset(212f, 143f))
            repeat(3) { i ->
                drawArc(
                    Color(0xFF329B9C),
                    -45f,
                    90f,
                    false,
                    Offset(435f + i * 19, 123f - i * 11),
                    Size(28f + i * 12, 72f + i * 22),
                    style = Stroke(3f),
                )
            }
            industrialLabel(label, 300f, 247f, ink, 20f)
        }
        "switch" -> {
            drawRoundRect(metal, Offset(205f, 128f), Size(180f, 110f), CornerRadius(10f))
            drawRoundRect(ink, Offset(232f, 142f), Size(126f, 76f), CornerRadius(7f))
            drawLine(ink, Offset(294f, 129f), Offset(377f, 63f), 12f)
            drawCircle(metal, 18f, Offset(382f, 60f))
            drawCircle(ink, 8f, Offset(382f, 60f))
            for (x in listOf(221f, 368f)) for (y in listOf(145f, 220f)) drawCircle(
                ink,
                5f,
                Offset(x, y),
            )
            industrialLabel(label, 295f, 185f, Color.White, 18f)
        }
        "transformer" -> {
            drawRoundRect(metal, Offset(145f, 70f), Size(310f, 164f), CornerRadius(8f))
            drawRect(ink, Offset(190f, 95f), Size(220f, 110f))
            for (x in listOf(200f, 330f)) {
                drawRoundRect(Color(0xFFC18149), Offset(x, 82f), Size(70f, 138f), CornerRadius(9f))
                repeat(12) { i ->
                    drawLine(
                        Color(0xFFF5BE76),
                        Offset(x + 4, 90f + i * 10),
                        Offset(x + 66, 90f + i * 10),
                        3f,
                    )
                }
            }
            industrialLabel(label, 300f, 270f, ink, 20f)
        }
        else -> {
            drawRoundRect(metal, Offset(170f, 46f), Size(260f, 195f), CornerRadius(13f))
            drawRoundRect(ink, Offset(186f, 85f), Size(228f, 108f), CornerRadius(7f))
            repeat(3) { i ->
                for (y in listOf(65f, 220f)) {
                    val x = 222f + i * 78
                    drawRoundRect(
                        Color(0xFF405B65),
                        Offset(x - 20, y - 11),
                        Size(40f, 22f),
                        CornerRadius(3f),
                    )
                    drawCircle(Color(0xFFC4D2D5), 7f, Offset(x, y))
                    drawLine(ink, Offset(x - 4, y), Offset(x + 4, y), 2f)
                }
            }
            if (kind == "contactor" || kind == "relay") {
                repeat(3) { i ->
                    drawLine(
                        Color(0xFFDBAF59),
                        Offset(220f + i * 76, 100f),
                        Offset(220f + i * 76, 176f),
                        4f,
                    )
                }
            } else
                repeat(7) { i ->
                    drawLine(
                        Color(0xFF69828E),
                        Offset(199f, 101f + i * 12),
                        Offset(260f, 101f + i * 12),
                        3f,
                    )
                }
            drawCircle(Color(0xFF79D6AE), 6f, Offset(390f, 104f))
            industrialLabel(label.take(22), 300f, 153f, Color.White, 19f)
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Places crisp original figure annotations in design coordinates, without fabricated component
 * ratings.
 *
 * @param text Technical identifier to draw.
 * @param x Text horizontal centre.
 * @param y Text baseline.
 * @param color Foreground chosen against its local illustration surface.
 * @param fontSize Design-space font size, scaled with the whole drawing.
 * @return Unit; native canvas errors propagate.
 */
private fun DrawScope.industrialLabel(
    text: String,
    x: Float,
    y: Float,
    color: Color,
    fontSize: Float,
) {
    drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(
        text,
        x,
        y,
        android.graphics.Paint(android.graphics.Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            this.color = color.toArgb()
            textSize = fontSize
            textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER
            typeface =
                android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    android.graphics.Typeface.SANS_SERIF,
                    android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD,
                )
        },
    )
}
````

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.ui.components

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.rememberScrollState
import androidx.compose.foundation.horizontalScroll
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.Stroke
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.nativeCanvas
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

/** Interactive generic meter illustration with explicit mode-dependent jack and connection notes.
 * @return Unit; this is an educational drawing, never a model-specific meter operating instruction.
 */
@Composable
fun MultimeterLesson() {
    var mode by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    val labels = listOf("DC volts", "AC volts", "Resistance", "Current")
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
        Row(Modifier.horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            labels.forEachIndexed { i, label -> FilterChip(mode == i, { mode = i }, label = { Text(label) }) }
        }
        Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(300.dp)) {
            val w = size.width; val h = size.height
            drawRoundRect(Color(0xFFF59E0B), Offset(w * .2f, 4f), Size(w * .6f, h - 8f), androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(28f))
            drawRoundRect(Color(0xFF172033), Offset(w * .23f, h * .03f), Size(w * .54f, h * .92f), androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(20f))
            drawRect(Color(0xFFCADAC8), Offset(w * .29f, h * .09f), Size(w * .42f, h * .2f))
            val paint = android.graphics.Paint(android.graphics.Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = android.graphics.Color.BLACK; textSize = w * .055f; textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER }
            drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(if (mode == 2) "Ω" else if (mode == 3) "A" else "V", w * .5f, h * .22f, paint)
            drawCircle(Color(0xFF42536A), h * .14f, Offset(w * .5f, h * .49f))
            val angle = (-120.0 + mode * 80) * Math.PI / 180
            drawLine(Color.White, Offset(w * .5f, h * .49f), Offset(w * .5f + kotlin.math.cos(angle).toFloat() * h * .1f, h * .49f + kotlin.math.sin(angle).toFloat() * h * .1f), 8f)
            paint.color = android.graphics.Color.WHITE; paint.textSize = w * .035f
            val xs = listOf(.34f, .5f, .66f)
            listOf("A / mA", "COM", "V / Ω").forEachIndexed { i, label ->
                drawCircle(if (i == 1) Color.Black else Color(0xFFEF4444), h * .035f, Offset(w * xs[i], h * .79f))
                drawCircle(Color.White, h * .035f, Offset(w * xs[i], h * .79f), style = Stroke(2f))
                drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(label, w * xs[i], h * .72f, paint)
            }
            drawLine(Color(0xFF07101E), Offset(w * .5f, h * .79f), Offset(w * .44f, h), 7f)
            drawLine(Color(0xFFEF4444), Offset(w * if (mode == 3) .34f else .66f, h * .79f), Offset(w * .9f, h * .98f), 7f)
        }
        Text("Generic ${labels[mode].lowercase()} illustration", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
        Text(when(mode) {
            2 -> "COM + V/Ω jack • power OFF, isolated and discharged • measure across the isolated part."
            3 -> "COM + correctly rated FUSED current jack • break the low-voltage circuit and insert the meter IN SERIES. Never across a source."
            else -> "COM + V/Ω jack • measure voltage IN PARALLEL. DC battery demonstration only; AC mains work requires a qualified procedure."
        })
        Text("Dial positions, current jack arrangements and ranges are illustrative. Match the real meter's labels and manual.", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
    }
}
````
