## app/src/main/java/com/electrokit/app/ui/components/ToolIcon.kt

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.ui.components

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.size
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.Stroke
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.nativeCanvas
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import kotlin.math.*

/**
 * Draws an original per-tool circuit motif at current density without raster resources.
 *
 * @param key Stable data key rather than a translated label.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun ToolIcon(key: String) {
    val light = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface.luminance() > .5f
    Canvas(Modifier.size(36.dp)) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val n = key.drop(1).toIntOrNull() ?: 1
        val ink =
            Color.hsv((n * 137.5f) % 360f, if (light) .65f else .38f, if (light) .55f else .9f)
        val gold = if (light) Color(0xFF926000) else Color(0xFFFFCE79)
        /**
         * Converts normalised icon coordinates into canvas proportions.
         *
         * @param x Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
         * @param y Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
         * @return A pixel-space Offset. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable
         *   persistence failures belong to the ViewModel.
         */
        fun p(x: Float, y: Float) = Offset(w * x, h * y)
        /**
         * Shares stroke styling between connected schematic segments so visual joins stay
         * consistent.
         *
         * @param x Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
         * @param y Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
         * @param a First endpoint or branch scalar in the enclosing drawing/equation.
         * @param b Second endpoint or branch scalar in the enclosing drawing/equation.
         * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
         *   observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence
         *   failures belong to the ViewModel.
         */
        fun line(x: Float, y: Float, a: Float, b: Float) =
            drawLine(ink, p(x, y), p(a, b), 2.dp.toPx(), StrokeCap.Round)
        /**
         * Draws a circuit annotation as vectors at the current canvas size.
         *
         * @param t Short visible symbol or component annotation.
         * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
         *   observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence
         *   failures belong to the ViewModel.
         */
        fun text(t: String) {
            drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(
                t,
                w / 2,
                h * .66f,
                android.graphics.Paint(3).apply {
                    color = ink.toArgb()
                    textSize = if (t.length > 2) 14 * density else 23 * density
                    textAlign = android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER
                    typeface =
                        android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                            "sans-serif-medium",
                            android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL,
                        )
                },
            )
        }
        val kind =
            if (key.startsWith("c")) n
            else if (key.startsWith("p")) 100 else if (key.startsWith("m")) 14 else (n % 5) + 100
        when (kind) {
            7 -> {
                line(.5f, .02f, .5f, .15f)
                drawRect(ink, p(.4f, .15f), Size(w * .2f, h * .24f), style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()))
                line(.5f, .39f, .5f, .58f)
                line(.5f, .48f, .95f, .48f)
                drawCircle(gold, 3.dp.toPx(), p(.5f, .48f))
                drawRect(ink, p(.4f, .58f), Size(w * .2f, h * .24f), style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()))
                line(.5f, .82f, .5f, .97f)
            }
            13,
            28 -> {
                line(.15f, .8f, .4f, .55f)
                line(.55f, .65f, .8f, .4f)
                drawRoundRect(
                    gold,
                    p(.25f, .16f),
                    Size(w * .45f, h * .45f),
                    CornerRadius(w * .2f),
                    style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()),
                )
                line(.72f, .2f, .9f, .05f)
                line(.8f, .3f, .98f, .15f)
            }

            1,
            9,
            25 -> {
                line(.02f, .5f, .22f, .5f)
                line(.78f, .5f, .98f, .5f)
                drawRoundRect(
                    ink,
                    p(.22f, .3f),
                    Size(w * .56f, h * .4f),
                    CornerRadius(4f),
                    style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()),
                )
                repeat(3) { i ->
                    drawLine(
                        if (i == 2) gold else ink,
                        p(.34f + i * .14f, .32f),
                        p(.34f + i * .14f, .68f),
                        3.dp.toPx(),
                    )
                }
            }
            3,
            18 -> {
                val path = Path()
                for (i in 0..90) {
                    val t = i / 90f
                    val x = w * (.08f + t * .84f)
                    val y = h * (.5f - .2f * sin(t * 6 * PI).toFloat())
                    if (i == 0) path.moveTo(x, y) else path.lineTo(x, y)
                }
                drawPath(path, ink, style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()))
            }
            10,
            11,
            101 -> {
                line(.05f, .5f, .4f, .5f)
                line(.4f, .2f, .4f, .8f)
                line(.6f, .2f, .6f, .8f)
                line(.6f, .5f, .95f, .5f)
            }
            5,
            6,
            22,
            31 -> {
                line(.12f, .85f, .95f, .85f)
                line(.12f, .85f, .12f, .12f)
                val path = Path()
                for (i in 0..80) {
                    val t = i / 80f
                    val y =
                        if (kind == 6) .7f - .6f * (1 - exp(-5 * t))
                        else .45f - .25f * sin(2 * PI * t).toFloat()
                    if (i == 0) path.moveTo(w * (.15f + t * .8f), h * y)
                    else path.lineTo(w * (.15f + t * .8f), h * y)
                }
                drawPath(path, ink, style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()))
            }
            12 -> {
                val path =
                    Path().apply {
                        moveTo(w * .2f, h * .15f)
                        lineTo(w * .82f, h * .5f)
                        lineTo(w * .2f, h * .85f)
                        close()
                    }
                drawPath(path, ink, style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()))
                line(.02f, .35f, .2f, .35f)
                line(.02f, .65f, .2f, .65f)
                line(.82f, .5f, .98f, .5f)
            }
            17 -> {
                drawRoundRect(
                    ink,
                    p(.2f, .2f),
                    Size(w * .6f, h * .65f),
                    CornerRadius(4f),
                    style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()),
                )
                line(.4f, .12f, .6f, .12f)
                line(.35f, .4f, .65f, .4f)
                line(.5f, .28f, .5f, .52f)
                line(.35f, .68f, .65f, .68f)
            }
            4 -> text("Ω")
            8 -> text("R₂/R₁")
            15 -> text("555")
            21 -> text("P")
            24 -> text("ƒ(x)")
            29 -> text("dB")
            30 -> text("⇄")
            else -> {
                drawRoundRect(
                    ink,
                    p(.15f, .23f),
                    Size(w * .7f, h * .54f),
                    CornerRadius(5f),
                    style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()),
                )
                repeat(3 + n % 2) { i ->
                    val x = .25f + i * .16f
                    drawCircle(gold, 2.dp.toPx(), p(x, .5f))
                    if (kind < 100) {
                        line(x, .08f, x, .23f)
                        line(x, .77f, x, .93f)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````kotlin
/**
 * Uses the Android plain-text chooser so the user decides which external application receives a
 * result.
 *
 * @param context Android context used only for local assets/storage or the user-directed share
 *   chooser.
 * @param text Input or output text as described above; treated as data, never executed.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
fun share(context: Context, text: String) {
    try {
    context.startActivity(
        Intent.createChooser(
            Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
                type = "text/plain"
                putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, text)
            },
            context.getString(R.string.share_chooser),
        )
    )
    } catch (_: android.content.ActivityNotFoundException) {
        android.widget.Toast.makeText(context, R.string.share_unavailable, android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }
}

/**
 * Connects navigation, lifecycle flushing and recoverable storage errors to one application host.
 *
 * @param vm Lifecycle-owned application state and persistence coordinator.
 * @param prefs Current immutable preference snapshot.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun ElectroApp(vm: AppViewModel, prefs: PreferencesState) {
    LifecycleEventEffect(Lifecycle.Event.ON_STOP) { vm.flushInputs() }
    val nav = rememberNavController()
    val engineering =
        androidx.lifecycle.viewmodel.compose.viewModel<
            com.electrokit.app.viewmodel.EngineeringViewModel
        >()
    val loaded by vm.loaded.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val err by vm.error.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    // A neutral brand loading surface avoids flashing the wrong persisted theme during migration.
    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = if (!loaded) BrandNavy else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        if (!loaded) {
            Column(
                Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
            ) {
                if (err == null) CircularProgressIndicator()
                else {
                    Text(err!!)
                    Button({ vm.retryLoading() }) { Text(stringResource(R.string.ui_retry)) }
                    TextButton({ vm.resetPreferences() }) {
                        Text(
                            stringResource(
                                R.string.ui_reset_damaged_preferences_clears_saved_settings
                            )
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            return@Surface
        }
        Column(
            Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)
                .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing)
                .imePadding()
        ) {
            if (err != null)
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Text(
                        err!!,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error,
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).padding(8.dp),
                    )
                    TextButton({ vm.retryFailedAction() }) {
                        Text(stringResource(R.string.ui_retry))
                    }
                    TextButton({ vm.dismissError() }) { Text(stringResource(R.string.ui_dismiss)) }
                }
            NavHost(nav, "main", Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                composable("main") {
                    MainScreen(
                        vm,
                        prefs,
                        { vm.visited(it); nav.navigate("entry/$it") },
                        { nav.navigate("info/$it") },
                        { nav.navigate("settings") },
                        engineering,
                        { nav.navigate("engineering/${android.net.Uri.encode(it)}") },
                    )
                }
                composable("engineering/{route}") { destination ->
                    EngineeringScreen(
                        destination.arguments?.getString("route") ?: "home",
                        engineering,
                        vm,
                        prefs,
                        { nav.navigate("engineering/${android.net.Uri.encode(it)}") },
                        { nav.navigate("entry/$it") },
                        { nav.popBackStack() },
                    )
                }
                composable("settings") {
                    Scaffold(
                        topBar = { Bar(stringResource(R.string.settings), { nav.popBackStack() }) }
                    ) { padding ->
                        ElectroSettings(vm, prefs, Modifier.padding(padding))
                    }
                }
                composable("plugins") {
                    Scaffold(
                        topBar = {
                            Bar(stringResource(R.string.plugins_title), { nav.popBackStack() })
                        }
                    ) { padding ->
                        Databases(
                            vm,
                            prefs,
                            Modifier.padding(padding),
                            { nav.navigate("entry/$it") },
                            { nav.navigate("info/1") },
                        )
                    }
                }
                composable("info/{tab}") { back ->
                    Info(
                        vm,
                        back.arguments?.getString("tab")?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
                        { nav.popBackStack() },
                    ) {
                        nav.navigate("entry/$it")
                    }
                }
                composable("entry/{id}") { back ->
                    val entry =
                        vm.repository.registry.firstOrNull {
                            it.id == back.arguments?.getString("id")
                        }
                    if (entry != null)
                        when (entry.screenType) {
                            "calculator" ->
                                CalculatorScreen(entry, vm, prefs) { nav.popBackStack() }
                            "module" -> ModuleScreen(entry, vm) { nav.popBackStack() }
                            else ->
                                ReferenceScreen(
                                    entry,
                                    vm.repository.pages.getValue(entry.contentId),
                                ) {
                                    nav.popBackStack()
                                }
                        }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Offers consistent navigation/actions while keeping child screens independent of the
 * NavController.
 *
 * @param title Visible calculator title used to select the intended test route.
 * @param back Caller-owned back-navigation callback.
 * @param brand True adds the original ElectroKit motif beside the title.
 * @param actions Child toolbar actions; large-font layout may put them below the title.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun Bar(
    title: String,
    back: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    brand: Boolean = false,
    actions: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit = {},
) {
    val scale = LocalDensity.current.fontScale
    CompositionLocalProvider(LocalContentColor provides Color.White) {
        BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(BrandNavy)) {
            val split = maxWidth < 380.dp || scale > 1.3f
            Column {
                Row(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 64.dp).padding(horizontal = 8.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                    if (back != null)
                        IconButton(back) {
                            Icon(Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack, stringResource(R.string.back))
                        }
                    Row(
                        Modifier.weight(1f).padding(vertical = 8.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    ) {
                        if (brand) {
                            Icon(
                                painterResource(R.drawable.ic_launcher),
                                stringResource(R.string.logo_description),
                                tint = Color.Unspecified,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp),
                            )
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                        }
                        Text(
                            title,
                            Modifier.weight(1f),
                            color = TopBarText,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                        )
                    }
                    if (!split)
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, content = actions)
                }
                if (split)
                    Row(
                        Modifier.align(Alignment.End).padding(end = 8.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        content = actions,
                    )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable

                )
            }
        }
        if (star != null)
            IconButton(onStar) {

                    ),

                    else stringResource(R.string.add_favourite),
                    tint = if (star) Heading else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                )
            }
        Icon(
            Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowForward,
            contentDescription = null,
            tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,

/**
 * Presents always-available offline databases with direct open actions for personal reference use.
 *
 * @param vm Lifecycle-owned application state and persistence coordinator.
 * @param prefs Current immutable preference snapshot.
 * @param modifier Caller-owned layout and semantics constraints.
 * @param openEntry Opens a stable registry route through caller-owned navigation.
 * @param onMore Opens the included-feature inventory.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun Databases(
    vm: AppViewModel,
    prefs: PreferencesState,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    openEntry: (String) -> Unit,
    onMore: () -> Unit,
) {
    var query by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    val cards =
        vm.repository.registry
            .filter { it.screenType == "module" && it.title.contains(query, true) }
            .sortedWith(
                compareByDescending<Entry> { it.id in prefs.favourites }
                    .thenBy { if (prefs.alphabetical) it.title else "" }
            )
    LazyColumn(modifier) {
        item { Search(query, { query = it }, stringResource(R.string.search_modules)) }
        item { Text(stringResource(R.string.module_intro), Modifier.padding(16.dp)) }
        items(cards, key = { it.id }) { entry ->
            val id = entry.id
            Column(
                Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(22.dp))
                    .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)
                    .padding(16.dp)
            ) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    EntryIcon(id)
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(16.dp))
                    Text(entry.title, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    IconButton({ vm.star(id) }) {
                        Icon(
                            painterResource(
                                if (id in prefs.favourites) R.drawable.ic_star_filled
                                else R.drawable.ic_star_outline
                            ),
                            if (id in prefs.favourites) stringResource(R.string.remove_favourite)
                            else stringResource(R.string.add_favourite),
                        )
                    }
                }
                Text(entry.description, Modifier.padding(vertical = 12.dp))
                TextButton({ openEntry(id) }) {
                    Text(
                        pluralStringResource(
                            R.plurals.open_module,
                            vm.repository.parts.getValue(id).size,
                            vm.repository.parts.getValue(id).size,
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
            HorizontalDivider(color = Divider)
        }
        item {
            Text(
                stringResource(R.string.more_features),
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clickable { onMore() }.padding(16.dp),
            )
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Displays product prose and a registry-derived inventory so included features stay aligned with
 * navigation.
 *
 * @param vm Lifecycle-owned application state and persistence coordinator.
 * @param initial Initial tab/default text, according to the enclosing operation.

 */
@Composable
fun Info(vm: AppViewModel, initial: Int, back: () -> Unit, openEntry: (String) -> Unit) {
    val catalogueLabels =
        mapOf(
            "CALCULATORS" to stringResource(R.string.tab_calculators),
            "PIN-OUTS" to stringResource(R.string.tab_pinouts),
            "RESOURCES" to stringResource(R.string.tab_resources),
            "PLUGINS" to stringResource(R.string.ui_plugins),
            "ENGINEERING" to stringResource(R.string.engine_tab),
        )

    var tab by rememberSaveable { mutableIntStateOf(initial) }
    val labels =
        listOf(
            stringResource(R.string.ui_info),
            stringResource(R.string.included),
            stringResource(R.string.changes),
            stringResource(R.string.credits),
        )
    Scaffold(
        topBar = {
            Column {
                Bar(stringResource(R.string.app_name), back)
                ScrollableTabRow(
                    tab,
                    containerColor = BrandNavy,
                    contentColor = TopBarText,
                ) {
                    labels.forEachIndexed { i, s -> Tab(tab == i, { tab = i }, text = { Text(s) }) }
                }
            }
        }
    ) { padding ->
        LazyColumn(Modifier.padding(padding)) {
            when (tab) {
                0 ->
                    item {
                        Text(
                            stringResource(R.string.info_body, BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME),
                            Modifier.padding(20.dp),
                        )
                    }
                1 ->
                    listOf("CALCULATORS", "PIN-OUTS", "RESOURCES", "PLUGINS").forEach { group ->
                        item {
                            Text(
                                catalogueLabels.getValue(group),
                                color = Heading,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp),
                            )
                        }
                        items(vm.repository.registry.filter { it.tab == group }, key = { it.id }) {
                            EntryRow(it, { openEntry(it.id) })
                        }
                    }
                2 ->
                    item {
                        Text(
                            stringResource(R.string.changes_body, BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME),
                            Modifier.padding(20.dp),
                        )
                    }
                3 -> item { Text(stringResource(R.string.credits_body), Modifier.padding(20.dp)) }
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Renders searchable JSON diagrams and copyable tables; visual USB column merging preserves
 * source/share data.
 *
 * @param entry Registry route and presentation metadata.
 * @param page Decoded offline reference content.
 * @param back Caller-owned back-navigation callback.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun ReferenceScreen(entry: Entry, page: Page, back: () -> Unit) {
    val usbHeaders =
        listOf(
            stringResource(R.string.usb_pin_header),
            stringResource(R.string.column_name),
            stringResource(R.string.column_description),
            stringResource(R.string.column_colour),
        )
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val clipboard = LocalClipboardManager.current
    var query by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    val scroll = rememberScrollState()
    val plain =
        remember(page) {
            page.title +
                "\n" +
                page.sections.joinToString("\n\n") { s ->
                    s.title +
                        "\n" +
                        s.headers.joinToString(" | ") +
                        "\n" +
                        s.rows.joinToString("\n") { it.joinToString(" | ") } +
                        "\n" +
                        s.notes
                } +
                "\n" +
                page.notes +
                "\n" +
                page.provenance
        }
    Scaffold(
        topBar = {
            Bar(entry.title, back) {
                TextButton({ share(context, plain) }) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Share, null, tint = TopBarText)
                    Text(stringResource(R.string.share_page), color = TopBarText, fontSize = 12.sp)
                }
            }
        }
    ) { padding ->
        Column(Modifier.padding(padding)) {
            Search(query, { query = it }, stringResource(R.string.search_reference))
            LazyColumn(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                item {
                    Text(
                        page.title,
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
                        color = Heading,
                        fontSize = 27.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        textAlign = androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextAlign.Start,
                    )
                }
                item {
                    Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 8.dp)) {
                        Text(
                            stringResource(R.string.provenance_heading),
                            color = Heading,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                        )
                        Text(
                            page.provenance,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            fontSize = 13.sp,
                        )
                    }
                }
                page.sections.forEachIndexed { index, s ->
                    val sourceRows =
                        s.rows.filter {
                            query.isBlank() ||
                                it.any { cell -> cell.contains(query, true) } ||
                                s.title.contains(query, true)
                        }
                    val usbTable = entry.contentId == "p1" && s.headers.size == 5
                    val headers = if (usbTable) usbHeaders else s.headers
                    val rows =
                        if (usbTable)
                            sourceRows.map { listOf(it[0] + " / " + it[1], it[2], it[3], it[4]) }
                        else sourceRows
                    if (rows.isNotEmpty() || query.isBlank()) {
                        item(key = "section$index") {
                            Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp)) {
                                Text(
                                    s.title,
                                    color = Heading,
                                    fontSize = 20.sp,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                )
                                if (query.isBlank()) {
                                    if (entry.contentId == "p1")
                                        s.diagrams.chunked(1).forEach { pair ->
                                            Row(
                                                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                                            ) {
                                                pair.forEach {
                                                    DiagramView(it, Modifier.weight(1f))
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    else s.diagrams.forEach { DiagramView(it) }
                                }
                                if (s.notes.isNotBlank())
                                    Text(
                                        s.notes,
                                        Modifier.padding(vertical = 8.dp),
                                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                    )
                            }
                        }
                        val compact = usbTable || headers.size <= 3
                        val widths =
                            if (usbTable) listOf(.15f, .18f, .43f, .24f)
                            else List(headers.size) { 1f / headers.size }
                        item(key = "tableHint$index") {
                            Text(
                                if (compact) stringResource(R.string.table_copy_hint)
                                else stringResource(R.string.table_scroll_hint),
                                Modifier.padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            )
                        }
                        stickyHeader(key = "header$index") {
                            Column(
                                Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp)
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 14.dp, topEnd = 14.dp))
                                    .background(BrandNavy)
                            ) {
                                Row(
                                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                                        .then(
                                            if (compact) Modifier.height(IntrinsicSize.Min)
                                            else Modifier.horizontalScroll(scroll)
                                        )
                                ) {
                                    headers.forEachIndexed { i, cell ->
                                        TableCell(
                                            cell,
                                            true,
                                            clipboard,
                                            if (compact) Modifier.weight(widths[i])
                                            else Modifier.width(160.dp),
                                            compact,
                                        )
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        itemsIndexed(rows) { rowIndex, row ->
                            Row(
                                Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp)
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .background(
                                        if (rowIndex % 2 == 0) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
                                        else
                                            MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant.copy(
                                                alpha = .5f
                                            )
                                    )
                                    .then(
                                        if (compact) Modifier.height(IntrinsicSize.Min)
                                        else Modifier.horizontalScroll(scroll)
                                    )
                            ) {
                                row.forEachIndexed { i, cell ->
                                    TableCell(
                                        cell,
                                        false,
                                        clipboard,
                                        if (compact) Modifier.weight(widths[i])
                                        else Modifier.width(160.dp),
                                        compact,
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                            HorizontalDivider(
                                Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp),
                                color = Divider.copy(alpha = .5f),
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
                item {
                    Column(Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
                        Text(page.notes, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                        if (page.sources.isNotEmpty()) {
                            Text(stringResource(R.string.ui_references), color = Heading)
                            page.sources.forEach {
                                Text(
                                    it,
                                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                                    modifier =
                                        Modifier.clickable {
                                                clipboard.setText(AnnotatedString(it))
                                            }
                                            .padding(vertical = 4.dp),
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Fills recognised wire-colour cells and chooses contrasting text for immediate identification.
 *
 * @param value Input scalar in the operation’s documented units.
 * @param header True selects the table heading style and contrast treatment.
 * @param clipboard Clipboard destination used only after an explicit cell tap.
 * @param modifier Caller-owned layout and semantics constraints.
 * @param compact True uses the phone-fitting cell layout instead of a horizontally scrollable
 *   width.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
private fun TableCell(
    value: String,
    header: Boolean,
    clipboard: androidx.compose.ui.platform.ClipboardManager,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    compact: Boolean = false,
) {
    val colour =
        when (value.lowercase().substringBefore(':').trim()) {
            "red" -> Color(0xFFC62828)
            "clear", "white" -> Color.White
            "green" -> Color(0xFF008000)
            "black" -> Color.Black
            "blue" -> Color(0xFF1565C0)
            "yellow" -> Color.Yellow
            "orange" -> Color(0xFFFF9800)
            "brown" -> Color(0xFF754123)
            "purple",
            "violet" -> Color(0xFF8E24AA)
            "grey",
            "slate" -> Color.Gray
            "tan" -> Color(0xFFD2B48C)
            "pink", "rose" -> Color(0xFFFFC0CB)
            "aqua" -> Color(0xFF00FFFF)
            else -> null
        }
    // Mixed wire colours use separate swatches so neither half compromises label contrast.
    val wireParts = value.substringBefore(':').lowercase().split('/').map { it.trim() }
    Row(
        modifier
            .heightIn(min = 52.dp)
            .then(if (compact) Modifier.fillMaxHeight() else Modifier)
            .background(if (header) BrandNavy else colour ?: Color.Transparent)
            .clickable { clipboard.setText(AnnotatedString(value)) }
            .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 14.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        if (!header && wireParts.size > 1 && wireParts.all { it in setOf("red", "blue", "green", "yellow", "black", "white", "grey", "gray", "pink", "rose", "brown", "violet", "purple", "orange", "tan", "aqua") }) {
            wireParts.forEach { part ->
                val wire = when (part) {
                    "red" -> Color(0xFFC62828)
                    "blue" -> Color(0xFF1565C0)
                    "green" -> Color(0xFF008000)
                    "yellow" -> Color.Yellow
                    "black" -> Color.Black
                    "white" -> Color.White
                    "grey", "gray" -> Color.Gray
                    "pink", "rose" -> Color(0xFFFFC0CB)
                    "brown" -> Color(0xFF754123)
                    "orange" -> Color(0xFFFF9800)
                    "tan" -> Color(0xFFD2B48C)
                    "aqua" -> Color(0xFF00FFFF)
                    "violet", "purple" -> Color(0xFF8E24AA)
                    else -> Color.Transparent
                }
                Box(Modifier.size(12.dp, 24.dp).background(wire))
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
        }
        Text(
            value,
            Modifier.weight(1f),
            fontSize = 14.sp,
            lineHeight = 21.sp,
            color =
                if (header) Color.White
                else if (colour != null) {
                    if (colour.luminance() > 0.179f) Color.Black else Color.White
                } else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
            fontWeight = if (header) FontWeight.SemiBold else FontWeight.Normal,
            fontStyle =
                if (value in listOf("Not connected", "Drain Wire")) FontStyle.Italic
                else FontStyle.Normal,
        )
    }
}

/**
 * Combines category/text filters with explicitly numeric metadata while leaving the bundled dataset
 * unchanged.
 *
 * @param entry Registry route and presentation metadata.
 * @param vm Lifecycle-owned application state and persistence coordinator.
 * @param back Caller-owned back-navigation callback.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun ModuleScreen(entry: Entry, vm: AppViewModel, back: () -> Unit) {
    var q by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    val allLabel = stringResource(R.string.all_categories)
    val anyLabel = stringResource(R.string.any_parameter)
    var category by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("All") }
    var field by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("Any") }
    var min by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    var max by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    val data = vm.repository.parts.getValue(entry.id)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val keys = remember(data) { listOf("Any") + data.flatMap { it.numericKeys }.distinct() }
    val filterError = NumericFilter.validation(min, max)
    val filtered =
        data.filter { p ->
            (category == "All" || p.category == category) &&
                (q.isBlank() ||
                    (p.name + " " + p.category + " " + p.specs.values.joinToString()).contains(
                        q,
                        true,
                    )) &&
                (field == "Any" ||
                    (field in p.numericKeys && NumericFilter.matches(p.specs[field], min, max)))
        }
    Scaffold(
        topBar = {
            Bar(entry.title, back) {
                IconButton({
                    share(
                        context,
                        filtered.joinToString("\n\n") {
                            it.name + "\n" + it.specs.entries.joinToString("\n")
                        },
                    )
                }) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Share, stringResource(R.string.share_filtered))
                }
            }
        }
    ) { padding ->
        Column(Modifier.padding(padding)) {
            Search(q, { q = it })
            Choice(
                stringResource(R.string.category),
                listOf("All") + data.map { it.category }.distinct(),
                category,
                { category = it },
                displayLabel = { if (it == "All") allLabel else it },
            )
            Choice(
                stringResource(R.string.numeric_parameter),
                keys,
                field,
                { field = it },
                displayLabel = { if (it == "Any") anyLabel else it },
            )
            if (field != "Any")
                Row {
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        min,
                        { min = it },
                        Modifier.weight(1f).padding(4.dp),
                        label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.ui_minimum)) },
                    )
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        max,
                        { max = it },
                        Modifier.weight(1f).padding(4.dp),
                        label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.ui_maximum)) },
                    )
                }
            if (field != "Any" && filterError != null)
                Text(
                    filterError,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error,
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(8.dp),
                )
            Text(
                pluralStringResource(R.plurals.part_count, filtered.size, filtered.size),
                Modifier.padding(8.dp),
                color = Heading,
            )
            LazyColumn(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                items(filtered, key = { it.name }) { part ->
                    var expanded by rememberSaveable(part.name) { mutableStateOf(false) }
                    Column(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clickable { expanded = !expanded }.padding(16.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text(part.name, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = Heading)
                        Text(part.category)
                        if (expanded) {
                            part.specs.forEach { (k, v) -> Text("$k: $v") }
                            Text(
                                stringResource(R.string.product_reference, part.source),
                                fontSize = 12.sp,
                            )
                            Text(stringResource(R.string.part_scope), fontStyle = FontStyle.Italic)
                        }
                    }
                    HorizontalDivider(color = Divider)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Presents a controlled dropdown so selection state remains with the mode/filter owner.
 *
 * @param label Visible field/cell caption used for accessible presentation.
 * @param options Stable option keys offered by this controlled dropdown.
 * @param selected Current stable option key; displayLabel may translate its visible caption.
 * @param onSelect Receives the selected stable key so the caller can retain or persist it.
 * @param modifier Caller-owned layout and semantics constraints.
 * @param displayLabel Maps stable option keys to visible captions without changing saved
 *   selections.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun Choice(
    label: String,
    options: List<String>,
    selected: String,
    onSelect: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    displayLabel: (String) -> String = { it },
) {
    // Translate labels at presentation only; callbacks and saveable state retain stable keys.
    val selectedLabel = displayLabel(selected)
    var expanded by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    Box(modifier.padding(4.dp)) {
        OutlinedButton({ expanded = true }, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 48.dp)) {
            Text(if (label.isBlank()) selectedLabel else "$label: $selectedLabel")
        }
        DropdownMenu(expanded, { expanded = false }) {
            options.forEach { s ->
                DropdownMenuItem(
                    text = { Text(displayLabel(s)) },
                    onClick = {
                        onSelect(s)
                        expanded = false
                    },
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.ui.screens

import androidx.compose.foundation.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.selection.selectable
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.KeyboardOptions
import androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.*
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.*
import androidx.compose.ui.*
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.Stroke
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.nativeCanvas
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.*
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.*
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.Role
import androidx.compose.ui.text.AnnotatedString
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.KeyboardType
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.*
import com.electrokit.app.R
import com.electrokit.app.data.*
import com.electrokit.app.domain.*
import com.electrokit.app.ui.components.*
import com.electrokit.app.ui.theme.*
import com.electrokit.app.viewmodel.AppViewModel
import kotlin.math.*

/**
 * Connects saveable raw input snapshots and unit selectors to live domain results without
 * persisting derived display text.
 *
 * @param entry Registry route and presentation metadata.
 * @param vm Lifecycle-owned application state and persistence coordinator.
 * @param prefs Current immutable preference snapshot.
 * @param back Caller-owned back-navigation callback.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun CalculatorScreen(entry: Entry, vm: AppViewModel, prefs: PreferencesState, back: () -> Unit) {
    val id = entry.id.drop(1).toInt()
    val spec = remember(id) { Calculators.spec(id) }
    val initial =
        remember(entry.id) {
            prefs.values[entry.id] ?: spec.fields.associate { it.key to it.initial }
        }
    var raw by rememberSaveable(entry.id) { mutableStateOf<Map<String, String>>(initial.toMap()) }
    var mode by
        rememberSaveable(entry.id) {
            mutableIntStateOf((prefs.modes[entry.id] ?: 0).coerceIn(spec.modes.indices))
        }
    var more by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var resetKey by rememberSaveable { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    val scaled =
        raw.mapValues { (k, v) ->
            val f = spec.fields.firstOrNull { it.key == k }
            if (f != null && !f.text && v.isNotBlank())
                Engineering.input(v, raw["unit_$k"]?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0, f.unit)?.toString()
                    ?: "Invalid or out-of-range input"
            else v
        }
    var bandResult by rememberSaveable(entry.id) { mutableStateOf("") }
    var calculated by remember(entry.id) { mutableStateOf<Calculation?>(null) }
    val result =
        calculated ?: if (id in listOf(1, 3)) Calculation.Value(bandResult)
        else Calculators.calculate(id, scaled, mode)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val clipboard = LocalClipboardManager.current
    /**
     * Transforms the latest preference record atomically; the ViewModel wrapper retains the exact
     * failed mutation for Retry.
     *
     * @param map New immutable field snapshot.
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures
     *   belong to the ViewModel.
     */
    fun update(map: Map<String, String>) {
        raw = map.toMap()
        calculated = null
        vm.values(entry.id, map)
    }
    val shareText =
        entry.title +
            "\n" +
            spec.modes[mode.coerceIn(spec.modes.indices)] +
            "\n" +
            spec.fields.joinToString("\n") {
                "${it.label}: ${if(it.text)raw[it.key].orEmpty() else Engineering.parse(scaled[it.key].orEmpty())?.let { value->Engineering.format(value,it.unit) } ?: raw[it.key].orEmpty()}"
            } +
            "\n" +
            result.text +
            "\n\n" +
            spec.formula
    Scaffold(
        topBar = {
            Bar(entry.title, back) {
                TextButton({ share(context, shareText) }) {
                    Icon(
                        Icons.Default.Share,
                        stringResource(R.string.share_results_description),
                        tint = Color.White,
                    )
                    Text(
                        stringResource(R.string.share_results),
                        color = Color.White,
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                    )
                }
                IconButton({ more = true }) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.MoreVert, stringResource(R.string.calculator_menu))
                }
                DropdownMenu(more, { more = false }) {
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                        text = { Text("Save calculation") },
                        onClick = { more = false; vm.saveCalculation(shareText) },
                    )
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                        text = { Text(stringResource(R.string.ui_reset)) },
                        onClick = {
                            more = false
                            mode = 0
                            vm.mode(entry.id, 0)
                            update(spec.fields.associate { it.key to it.initial })
                            resetKey++
                        },
                    )
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                        text = { Text(stringResource(R.string.ui_copy_result)) },
                        onClick = {
                            more = false
                            clipboard.setText(AnnotatedString(shareText))
                        },
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    ) { padding ->
        if (id == 1 || id == 3) {
            key(resetKey) {
                BandScreen(
                    id == 3,
                    raw,
                    { update(it) },
                    { bandResult = it },
                    Modifier.padding(padding),
                )
            }
            return@Scaffold
        }
        Column(Modifier.padding(padding).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(12.dp)) {
            Text("ENGINEERING WORKBENCH", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = Heading)
            Text(entry.title, style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall, modifier = Modifier.padding(vertical = 12.dp))
            if (spec.modes.size > 1)
                Choice(
                    stringResource(R.string.mode),
                    spec.modes,
                    spec.modes[mode.coerceIn(spec.modes.indices)],
                    {
                        mode = spec.modes.indexOf(it)
                        calculated = null
                        vm.mode(entry.id, mode)
                    },
                )
            if (id == 24) {
                FormulaBrowser(vm.repository.registry)
                return@Column
            }
            Text(
                stringResource(R.string.inputs),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 12.dp),
            )
            Text(
                stringResource(R.string.live_hint),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(bottom = 8.dp),
            )
            spec.fields
                .filter { field ->
                    id != 12 ||
                        when (field.key) {
                            "v2" -> mode >= 2
                            "r3" -> mode == 2
                            else -> true
                        }
                }
                .forEach { field ->
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        OutlinedTextField(
                            raw[field.key].orEmpty(),
                            { update(raw + (field.key to it)) },
                            Modifier.weight(1f).padding(vertical = 5.dp),
                            shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                            label = { Text(field.label) },
                            supportingText = {
                                Text(
                                    if (
                                        Engineering.ignoresSelector(
                                            raw[field.key].orEmpty(),
                                            raw["unit_${field.key}"]?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
                                        )
                                    )
                                        stringResource(R.string.suffix_hint)
                                    else if (field.unit.isBlank())
                                        stringResource(R.string.decimal_hint)
                                    else stringResource(R.string.base_unit_hint, field.unit)
                                )
                            },
                            keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Text),
                            singleLine = !field.text,
                        )
                        if (field.unit in listOf("Ω", "F", "H", "V", "A", "Hz", "s", "W")) {
                            val units =
                                listOf("p", "n", "µ", "m", "", "k", "M", "G").map {
                                    it + field.unit
                                }
                            val exponents = listOf(-12, -9, -6, -3, 0, 3, 6, 9)
                            val e = raw["unit_${field.key}"]?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
                            Choice(
                                "",
                                units,
                                units[exponents.indexOf(e).coerceAtLeast(0)],
                                {
                                    update(
                                        raw +
                                            ("unit_${field.key}" to
                                                exponents[units.indexOf(it)].toString())
                                    )
                                },
                                Modifier.width(95.dp),
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Button(onClick = { calculated = Calculators.calculate(id, scaled, mode) }) { Text("Calculate") }
                OutlinedButton(onClick = {
                    mode = 0; calculated = null; vm.mode(entry.id, 0)
                    update(spec.fields.associate { it.key to it.initial })
                }) { Text("Reset") }
            }
            Card(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 16.dp),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp),
                colors =
                    CardDefaults.cardColors(
                        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = .10f)
                    ),
            ) {
                Column(Modifier.padding(20.dp)) {
                    Text(
                        stringResource(R.string.ui_result),
                        color = Heading,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    )
                    Text(
                        result.text,
                        color =
                            if (result is Calculation.Error) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error
                            else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp),
                    )
                    ResponsePlot(result.plot)
                }
            }
            if (id == 25) {
                runCatching {
                        Resistors.encode(Engineering.parse(scaled["v"].orEmpty()) ?: 0.0, mode == 1)
                    }
                    .getOrNull()
                    ?.let { b ->
                        ResistorDrawing(
                            b.dropLast(1) +
                                when (b.last()) {
                                    -1 -> 10
                                    -2 -> 11
                                    else -> b.last()
                                } +
                                if (mode == 1) 1 else 10
                        )
                    }
            }
            if (id == 15) TimerCircuit(mode == 1)
            if (id == 27) TransformationDiagram()
            Text(
                stringResource(R.string.ui_formula_assumptions),
                color = Heading,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            )
            Text(spec.formula, Modifier.padding(vertical = 8.dp))
            Text("Substitution", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
            spec.fields.forEach { field ->
                Text("${field.label} = ${raw[field.key].orEmpty().ifBlank { "not entered" }} ${field.unit}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium)
            }
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                TextButton({ clipboard.setText(AnnotatedString(shareText)) }) { Text("Copy result") }
                TextButton({ vm.saveCalculation(shareText) }) { Text("Save result") }
            }
            Text(
                stringResource(R.string.input_convention),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            )
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Keeps the band palette, component drawing and shared result text in sync for resistance and
 * inductance references.
 *
 * @param inductor True draws a coil whose encoded value is in microhenries.
 * @param raw Saved/raw text; null represents an absent record.
 * @param save Supplied (Map<String, String>) -> Unit value consumed by the operation described
 *   above.
 * @param onResult Receives current band-result text for copying and sharing.
 * @param modifier Caller-owned layout and semantics constraints.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun BandScreen(
    inductor: Boolean,
    raw: Map<String, String>,
    save: (Map<String, String>) -> Unit,
    onResult: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val bandDescriptionTemplate = stringResource(R.string.band_description)
    var five by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(raw["five"] == "true") }
    /**
     * Clamps restored colour indices before table indexing so damaged preferences cannot crash the
     * screen.
     *
     * @param k Stable field key used to read or update the saved calculator snapshot.
     * @param default Fallback band index used when no valid persisted selection exists.
     * @return A valid colour-table index after clamping restored state. Rendering/callback failures
     *   propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the ViewModel.
     */
    fun read(k: String, default: Int): Int {
        val parsed = raw[k]?.toIntOrNull() ?: default
        return when (k) {
            "d1" -> parsed.coerceIn(1, 9)
            "d2",
            "d3" -> parsed.coerceIn(0, 9)
            "mult" -> parsed.coerceIn(0, 11)
            else -> parsed.takeIf { it in Resistors.tolerance } ?: default
        }
    }
    val digits =
        if (five) listOf(read("d1", 1), read("d2", 1), read("d3", 0))
        else listOf(read("d1", 1), read("d2", 1))
    val mult = read("mult", 2)
    val tol = read("tol", 10)
    val value =
        runCatching {
                Resistors.decode(
                    digits,
                    when (mult) {
                        10 -> -1
                        11 -> -2
                        else -> mult
                    },
                )
            }
            .getOrNull()
    val text =
        if (value != null)
            Engineering.format(if (inductor) value * 1e-6 else value, if (inductor) "H" else "Ω") +
                " ±${Engineering.percent(Resistors.tolerance[tol]?:5.0)}"
        else stringResource(R.string.invalid_bands)
    LaunchedEffect(text) { onResult(text) }
    /**
     * Sends a new immutable band snapshot rather than mutating a map shared with persistence.
     *
     * @param k Stable field key used to read or update the saved calculator snapshot.
     * @param v Voltage in volts, or resistance scalar when used by the SMD encoder.
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures
     *   belong to the ViewModel.
     */
    fun set(k: String, v: Int) {
        save(raw + (k to v.toString()))
    }
    Column(modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(8.dp)) {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Text(stringResource(R.string.use_five_bands), Modifier.weight(1f))
            Switch(
                five,
                { next ->
                    val b = value?.let { runCatching { Resistors.encode(it, next) }.getOrNull() }
                    five = next
                    val additions = mutableMapOf("five" to next.toString())
                    if (b != null) {
                        b.dropLast(1).forEachIndexed { i, d -> additions["d${i+1}"] = d.toString() }
                        additions["mult"] =
                            when (b.last()) {
                                -1 -> 10
                                -2 -> 11
                                else -> b.last()
                            }.toString()
                    }
                    save(raw + additions)
                },
            )
        }
        ResistorDrawing(digits + mult + tol, inductor)
        Row(
            Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterHorizontally),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
            Text(text, fontSize = 24.sp)
            Icon(
                if (value != null) Icons.Default.Check else Icons.Default.Close,
                if (value != null) stringResource(R.string.valid)
                else stringResource(R.string.invalid),
                tint = if (value != null) Heading else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(12.dp),
            )
        }
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            val keys =
                if (five) listOf("d1", "d2", "d3", "mult", "tol")
                else listOf("d1", "d2", "mult", "tol")
            keys.forEach { key ->
                val options =
                    when (key) {
                        "d1" -> (1..9).toList()
                        "d2",
                        "d3" -> (0..9).toList()
                        "mult" -> (0..11).toList()
                        else -> listOf(1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11)
                    }
                val selected =
                    when (key) {
                        "d1" -> digits[0]
                        "d2" -> digits[1]
                        "d3" -> digits.getOrElse(2) { 0 }
                        "mult" -> mult
                        else -> tol
                    }
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                    Text(
                        when (key) {
                            "mult" -> "×"
                            "tol" -> "±"
                            else -> key.removePrefix("d")
                        },
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    )
                    (0..11).forEach { colour ->
                        if (colour !in options) Spacer(Modifier.height(52.dp))
                        else {
                            val base = BandColours[colour]
                            val selectedNow = colour == selected
                            Column(
                                Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                                    .heightIn(min = 52.dp)
                                    .padding(3.dp)
                                    .semantics {
                                        contentDescription =
                                            Resistors.names[colour] +
                                                " " +
                                                key +
                                                if (key == "tol")
                                                    bandDescriptionTemplate.format(
                                                        java.util.Locale.getDefault(),
                                                        Resistors.tolerance[colour],
                                                    )
                                                else ""
                                        this.selected = selectedNow
                                    }
                                    .selectable(
                                        selectedNow,
                                        role = Role.RadioButton,
                                        onClick = { set(key, colour) },
                                    ),
                                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                            ) {
                                Box(
                                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                                        .height(25.dp)
                                        .background(
                                            Brush.verticalGradient(
                                                listOf(
                                                    base.copy(
                                                        alpha = if (selectedNow) 1f else .42f
                                                    ),
                                                    Color.White.copy(
                                                        alpha = if (selectedNow) .5f else .08f
                                                    ),
                                                    base.copy(alpha = if (selectedNow) 1f else .42f),
                                                )
                                            ),
                                            RoundedCornerShape(2.dp),
                                        )
                                        .border(
                                            if (selectedNow) 2.dp else 0.5.dp,
                                            if (selectedNow) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
                                            else Color.Gray,
                                            RoundedCornerShape(2.dp),
                                        )
                                )
                                Text(
                                    if (key == "tol")
                                        Engineering.percent(Resistors.tolerance.getValue(colour))
                                    else Resistors.names[colour],
                                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                                    maxLines = 2,
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Searches the shipping calculator specifications instead of maintaining a second formula
 * catalogue.
 *
 * @param registry Shipping catalogue used to derive formula titles without a duplicate index.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun FormulaBrowser(registry: List<Entry>) {
    var q by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    Search(q, { q = it }, stringResource(R.string.search_formulas))
    registry
        .filter { it.screenType == "calculator" && it.id != "c24" }
        .map { it.title to Calculators.spec(it.id.drop(1).toInt()).formula }
        .filter { (title, formula) -> (title + " " + formula).contains(q, true) }
        .forEach { (title, formula) ->
            Text(title, color = Heading, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
            Text(formula, Modifier.padding(bottom = 14.dp))
        }
}

/**
 * Draws the selected NE555 timing network with original vectors and an accessible description.
 *
 * @param mono True selects the monostable timing network.
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun TimerCircuit(mono: Boolean) {
    // Resources must resolve before the non-composable Canvas draw callback executes.
    val circuitLabels =
        mapOf(
            "NE555" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_0),
            "VCC" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_1),
            "8,4" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_2),
            "1" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_3),
            "GND" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_4),
            "3 OUT" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_5),
            "RA" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_6),
            "RB" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_7),
            "2,6" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_8),
            "2 TRIG" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_9),
            "C" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_10),
            "5" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_11),
            "10 nF" to stringResource(R.string.timing_label_12),
        )
    val circuitDescription =
        if (mono) stringResource(R.string.mono_accessibility)
        else stringResource(R.string.astable_accessibility)
    val fg = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
    Text(
        if (mono) stringResource(R.string.mono_description)
        else stringResource(R.string.astable_description),
        color = Heading,
    )
    Canvas(
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(260.dp).semantics { contentDescription = circuitDescription }
    ) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        /**
         * Converts normalised drawing coordinates into pixel-space offsets so geometry scales with
         * the available canvas.
         *
         * @param x Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
         * @param y Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
         * @return A pixel-space Offset. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable
         *   persistence failures belong to the ViewModel.
         */
        fun pt(x: Float, y: Float) = Offset(w * x, h * y)
        /**
         * Shares stroke styling between connected schematic segments so visual joins stay
         * consistent.
         *
         * @param x1 Normalised horizontal start coordinate, scaled by this canvas width.
         * @param y1 Normalised vertical start coordinate, scaled by this canvas height.
         * @param x2 Normalised horizontal end coordinate, scaled by this canvas width.
         * @param y2 Normalised vertical end coordinate, scaled by this canvas height.
         * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
         *   observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence
         *   failures belong to the ViewModel.
         */
        fun line(x1: Float, y1: Float, x2: Float, y2: Float) =
            drawLine(fg, pt(x1, y1), pt(x2, y2), 2.dp.toPx())
        /**
         * Draws a circuit annotation as vectors at the current canvas size.
         *
         * @param s Annotation text drawn inside the timing-network canvas.
         * @param x Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
         * @param y Coordinate in this renderer’s documented canvas space.
         * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
         *   observable state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence
         *   failures belong to the ViewModel.
         */
        fun text(s: String, x: Float, y: Float) {
            drawContext.canvas.nativeCanvas.drawText(
                s,
                w * x,
                h * y,
                android.graphics.Paint(3).apply {
                    color = fg.toArgb()
                    textSize = 12 * density
                },
            )
        }
        drawRect(fg, pt(.4f, .26f), Size(w * .3f, h * .44f), style = Stroke(2.dp.toPx()))
        text(circuitLabels.getValue("NE555"), .45f, .5f)
        line(.12f, .1f, .8f, .1f)
        text(circuitLabels.getValue("VCC"), .02f, .12f)
        line(.52f, .1f, .52f, .26f)
        text(circuitLabels.getValue("8,4"), .53f, .23f)
        line(.55f, .7f, .55f, .9f)
        text(circuitLabels.getValue("1"), .57f, .8f)
        line(.12f, .9f, .8f, .9f)
        text(circuitLabels.getValue("GND"), .82f, .92f)
        line(.7f, .45f, .88f, .45f)
        text(circuitLabels.getValue("3 OUT"), .74f, .4f)
        line(.18f, .1f, .18f, .18f)
        drawRect(fg, pt(.15f, .18f), Size(w * .06f, h * .13f), style = Stroke(2f))
        text(circuitLabels.getValue("RA"), .06f, .27f)
        line(.18f, .31f, .18f, .38f)
        line(.18f, .38f, .4f, .38f)
        text(if (mono) "6,7" else "7", .31f, .36f)
        if (!mono) {
            drawRect(fg, pt(.15f, .43f), Size(w * .06f, h * .13f), style = Stroke(2f))
            line(.18f, .38f, .18f, .43f)
            line(.18f, .56f, .18f, .65f)
            line(.18f, .65f, .4f, .65f)
            text(circuitLabels.getValue("RB"), .06f, .52f)
            text(circuitLabels.getValue("2,6"), .31f, .62f)
        } else {
            line(.18f, .38f, .18f, .65f)
            line(.03f, .62f, .4f, .62f)
            text(circuitLabels.getValue("2 TRIG"), .03f, .59f)
        }
        line(.18f, .65f, .18f, .72f)
        line(.12f, .72f, .24f, .72f)
        line(.12f, .77f, .24f, .77f)
        line(.18f, .77f, .18f, .9f)
        text(circuitLabels.getValue("C"), .25f, .77f)
        line(.7f, .63f, .78f, .63f)
        line(.78f, .63f, .78f, .73f)
        line(.74f, .73f, .82f, .73f)
        line(.74f, .77f, .82f, .77f)
        line(.78f, .77f, .78f, .9f)
        text(circuitLabels.getValue("5"), .72f, .61f)
        text(circuitLabels.getValue("10 nF"), .81f, .76f)
    }
    Text(stringResource(R.string.timer_note), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
}

/**
 * Explains star/delta topology with original vectors instead of downloaded artwork.
 *
 * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or observable
 *   state. Rendering/callback failures propagate; recoverable persistence failures belong to the
 *   ViewModel.
 */
@Composable
fun TransformationDiagram() {
    val diagramDescription = stringResource(R.string.transformation_accessibility)
    val fg = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
    Canvas(
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(150.dp).semantics { contentDescription = diagramDescription }
    ) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val a = Offset(w * .25f, h * .1f)
        val b = Offset(w * .05f, h * .9f)
        val c = Offset(w * .45f, h * .9f)
        val mid = Offset(w * .25f, h * .6f)
        listOf(a, b, c).forEach { drawLine(fg, it, mid, 4f) }
        val p =
            Path().apply {
                moveTo(w * .75f, h * .1f)
                lineTo(w * .55f, h * .9f)
                lineTo(w * .95f, h * .9f)
                close()
            }
        drawPath(p, fg, style = Stroke(4f))
    }
}
````
