````kotlin
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/** Shared bitmap budget; large reference sheets never load into the scrolling catalogue. */
private val imageCache = object : LruCache<String, android.graphics.Bitmap>(8 * 1024 * 1024) {
    /** Counts actual decoded memory rather than compressed asset bytes.
     * @param key Asset-and-resolution cache key.
     * @param value Decoded bitmap.
     * @return Decoded allocation size in bytes.
     */
    override fun sizeOf(key: String, value: android.graphics.Bitmap): Int = value.byteCount
}

/** Decodes local component art on IO at bounded resolution; a failed asset has a visible fallback.
 * @param asset Bundled image metadata; not a verified manufacturer photograph.
 * @param modifier Caller-owned image bounds.
 * @param detail True permits a larger sampled decode for a detail page.
 * @return Unit; failed image decoding produces a readable fallback and never triggers network I/O.
 */
@Composable
fun ComponentImage(asset: ComponentAsset, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, detail: Boolean = false) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val target = if (detail) 1024 else 256
    val key = "${asset.image}:$target"
    var bitmap by remember(key) { mutableStateOf(imageCache.get(key)) }
    LaunchedEffect(key) {
        bitmap = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            imageCache.get(key) ?: runCatching {
                val bounds = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }
                context.assets.open(asset.image).use { BitmapFactory.decodeStream(it, null, bounds) }
                val options = BitmapFactory.Options().apply {
                    inSampleSize = 1
                    while (bounds.outWidth / inSampleSize > target * 2 || bounds.outHeight / inSampleSize > target * 2) inSampleSize *= 2
                }
                context.assets.open(asset.image).use { BitmapFactory.decodeStream(it, null, options) }
            }.getOrNull()?.also { imageCache.put(key, it) }
        }
    }
    Box(modifier.background(Color(0xFFEEF2F6)), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
        bitmap?.let { Image(it.asImageBitmap(), asset.name, Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(8.dp), contentScale = ContentScale.Fit) }
            ?: Text(asset.name, color = Color(0xFF172033), modifier = Modifier.padding(12.dp))
    }
}

/** Five stable destinations wrap the original registry, calculators, databases and engineering routes.
 * @param vm Existing catalogue, preferences and input-persistence owner.
 * @param prefs Latest immutable committed preference snapshot.
 * @param openEntry Opens an original public registry route.
 * @param info Opens an existing information tab.
 * @param settings Opens the standalone appearance page.
 * @param engineering Existing source-traceable engineering asset owner.
 * @param openEngineering Opens a protected engineering route through its shared session gate.
 * @return Unit after composing the selected destination; storage errors remain visible in the host banner.
 */
@Composable
fun MainScreen(vm: AppViewModel, prefs: PreferencesState, openEntry: (String) -> Unit,
    info: (Int) -> Unit, settings: () -> Unit, engineering: EngineeringViewModel, openEngineering: (String) -> Unit) {
    var tab by rememberSaveable { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var query by rememberSaveable(tab) { mutableStateOf("") }
    var category by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("Calculators") }
    var detail by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var menu by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    BackHandler(enabled = detail != null) { detail = null }
    BackHandler(enabled = detail == null && tab != 0) { tab = 0; query = "" }
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val components by produceState<List<ComponentAsset>>(emptyList()) { value = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { loadComponents(context) } }
    val access: EngineeringAccess = viewModel(context as ComponentActivity)
    val publicComponents = components.filter { it.category != "Escalator" }
    val names = listOf("Home", "Tools", "Learn", "Favorites", "Settings")
    val component = components.firstOrNull { detail == "component:${it.id}" }
    val lesson = learningPages.firstOrNull { detail == "learn:${it.id}" }
    val utility = WorkbenchTools.all.firstOrNull { detail == "utility:${it.id}" }
    if (detail == "unit-converter") { UnitConverterScreen { detail = null }; return }
    if (utility != null) { UtilityScreen(utility, vm, prefs) { detail = null }; return }
    if (component != null) {
        val screen: @Composable () -> Unit = { ComponentDetail(component, prefs, vm) { detail = null } }
        if (component.category == "Escalator") EngineeringGate({ detail = null }, screen) else screen()
        return
    }
    if (lesson != null) { LearningDetail(lesson, prefs, vm) { detail = null }; return }
    Scaffold(
        contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0, 0, 0, 0),
        topBar = {
            Column {
                Bar("ELECTRO", brand = true) {
                    IconButton(onClick = { info(0) }) { Icon(Icons.Default.Info, "Info") }
                    IconButton(onClick = { menu = true }) { Icon(Icons.Default.MoreVert, "Menu") }
                    DropdownMenu(menu, { menu = false }) {
                        DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("Settings") }, onClick = { menu = false; settings() })
                        DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("About ELECTRO") }, onClick = { menu = false; info(0) })
                    }
                }
                if (tab != 4 && !(tab == 1 && category in listOf("Data", "Engineering"))) Search(query, { query = it })
            }
        },
        bottomBar = {
            NavigationBar(Modifier.testTag("main_navigation").height((64f + 64f * (LocalDensity.current.fontScale - 1f).coerceAtLeast(0f)).dp), windowInsets = WindowInsets(0, 0, 0, 0)) {
                names.forEachIndexed { i, name ->
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight().selectable(selected = tab == i, role = Role.Tab,
                        onClick = { tab = i; query = ""; if (i == 1) category = "Calculators"; if (i == 2) category = "Components" })
                        .padding(horizontal = 2.dp, vertical = 8.dp), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center) {
                        Box(Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(24.dp)).background(if (tab == i) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondaryContainer else Color.Transparent)
                            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 4.dp)) {
                            Icon(when(i) { 0 -> Icons.Default.Home; 1 -> Icons.Default.Settings; 2 -> Icons.Default.Info; 3 -> Icons.Default.Star; else -> Icons.Default.MoreVert }, null, Modifier.size(24.dp))
                        }
                        Text(name, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), maxLines = 2, minLines = if (LocalDensity.current.fontScale > 1.3f) 2 else 1,
                            fontSize = if (LocalDensity.current.fontScale > 1.3f) 9.sp else 11.sp, lineHeight = 14.sp, textAlign = androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextAlign.Center)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    ) { padding ->
        val body = Modifier.padding(padding).fillMaxSize()
        when (tab) {
            0 -> LazyColumn(body, contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                item {
                    Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clip(RoundedCornerShape(28.dp))
                        .background(Brush.linearGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF17366B), Color(0xFF123E52)))).padding(24.dp)) {
                        Text("YOUR ENGINEERING WORKBENCH", color = Color(0xFFBAE6FD), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium)
                        Text("Build understanding.\nSolve with confidence.", color = Color.White, style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(vertical = 12.dp))
                        Text("Electrical • Electronics • Engineering", color = Color(0xFFDAE6FF))
                        FilledTonalButton({ tab = 1 }, Modifier.padding(top = 16.dp)) { Text("Explore tools") }
                    }
                }
                if (query.isBlank()) {
                    item { SectionTitle("Explore ELECTRO") }
                    item { Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        QuickCard("Calculators", Modifier.weight(1f)) { tab = 1; category = "Calculators" }
                        QuickCard("Components", Modifier.weight(1f)) { tab = 2; category = "Components" }
                    } }
                    item { Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        QuickCard("Pin-outs", Modifier.weight(1f)) { tab = 1; category = "Pin-outs" }
                        QuickCard("Escalator", Modifier.weight(1f)) { openEngineering("home") }
                    } }
                    item { SectionTitle("Featured calculators") }
                }
                items(vm.repository.registry.filter { it.screenType == "calculator" && it.title.contains(query, true) }.take(if (query.isBlank()) 3 else 100), key = { it.id }) {
                    EntryRow(it, { openEntry(it.id) }, it.id in prefs.favourites) { vm.star(it.id) }
                }
                if (query.isNotBlank()) {
                    items(publicComponents.filter { it.name.contains(query, true) }.take(12), key = { "asset:${it.id}" }) { c ->
                        ListItem(headlineContent = { Text(c.name) }, supportingContent = { Text(c.category) }, modifier = Modifier.clickable { detail = "component:${c.id}" })
                    }
                    items(learningPages.filter { it.title.contains(query, true) }) { page ->
                        QuickCard(page.title, Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { detail = "learn:${page.id}" }
                    }
                } else {
                    if (prefs.recent.isNotEmpty()) {
                        item { SectionTitle("Recently used") }
                        items(prefs.recent.mapNotNull { id -> vm.repository.registry.find { it.id == id } }) {
                            EntryRow(it, { openEntry(it.id) }, it.id in prefs.favourites) { vm.star(it.id) }
                        }
                    }
                    item { SectionTitle("Component discovery") }
                    items(publicComponents.filter { it.id in listOf("digital_multimeter", "magnetic_contactor", "axial_resistor") }) { c ->
                        Card(onClick = { detail = "component:${c.id}" }, shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp)) {
                            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                ComponentImage(c, Modifier.size(104.dp))
                                Column(Modifier.padding(16.dp)) { Text(c.name, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium); Text(c.category, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall) }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            1 -> Column(body) {
                LazyRow(contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 16.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    items(listOf("Calculators", "Pin-outs", "Reference", "Data", "Engineering", "Utilities")) { name ->
                        FilterChip(category == name, { category = name }, label = { Text(name) })
                    }
                }
                when (category) {
                    "Utilities" -> LazyColumn(contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                        item { QuickCard("Engineering unit converter", Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { detail = "unit-converter" } }
                        items(WorkbenchTools.all.filter { it.title.contains(query, true) }) { tool ->
                            QuickCard(tool.title, Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { detail = "utility:${tool.id}" }
                        }
                    }
                    "Data" -> Databases(vm, prefs, Modifier.weight(1f), openEntry, { info(1) })
                    "Engineering" -> EngineeringScreen("home", engineering, vm, prefs, openEngineering, openEntry)
                    else -> {
                        val group = when(category) { "Pin-outs" -> "PIN-OUTS"; "Reference" -> "RESOURCES"; else -> "CALCULATORS" }
                        val entries = vm.repository.registry.filter { (it.tab == group || (group == "CALCULATORS" && it.screenType == "module")) && it.title.contains(query, true) }
                            .sortedWith(compareByDescending<Entry> { it.id in prefs.favourites }.thenBy { if (prefs.alphabetical) it.title else "" })
                        LazyColumn(Modifier.weight(1f), contentPadding = PaddingValues(8.dp)) {
                            item { SectionTitle("${entries.size} ${category.lowercase()}") }
                            items(entries, key = { it.id }) { entry -> EntryRow(entry, { openEntry(entry.id) }, entry.id in prefs.favourites) { vm.star(entry.id) } }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            2 -> Column(body) {
                LazyRow(contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 16.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    items(listOf("Components", "Lessons", "Escalator images")) { name -> FilterChip(category == name, { category = name }, label = { Text(name) }) }
                }
                if (category == "Lessons") LazyColumn {
                    items(learningPages.filter { it.title.contains(query, true) }) { page ->
                        QuickCard(page.title, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(12.dp)) { detail = "learn:${page.id}" }
                    }
                } else {
                    val gallery: @Composable () -> Unit = {
                        LazyVerticalGrid(GridCells.Adaptive(150.dp), contentPadding = PaddingValues(12.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                            gridItems((if (category == "Escalator images") components.filter { it.category == "Escalator" } else publicComponents)
                                .filter { it.name.contains(query, true) || it.category.contains(query, true) }, key = { it.id }) { c ->
                                Card(onClick = { detail = "component:${c.id}" }, shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp)) {
                                    ComponentImage(c, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().aspectRatio(1f))
                                    Text(c.name, Modifier.padding(12.dp), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (category == "Escalator images") EngineeringGate(content = gallery) else gallery()
                }
            }
            3 -> LazyColumn(body, contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                item { SectionTitle("Your favorites") }
                items(vm.repository.registry.filter { it.id in prefs.favourites && it.title.contains(query, true) }) {
                    EntryRow(it, { openEntry(it.id) }, true) { vm.star(it.id) }
                }
                items(publicComponents.filter { "component:${it.id}" in prefs.favourites && it.name.contains(query, true) }) { c ->
                    QuickCard(c.name, Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { detail = "component:${c.id}" }
                }
                if (access.unlocked) items(components.filter { it.category == "Escalator" && "component:${it.id}" in prefs.favourites && it.name.contains(query, true) }) { c ->
                    QuickCard(c.name, Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { detail = "component:${c.id}" }
                }
                items(learningPages.filter { "learn:${it.id}" in prefs.favourites && it.title.contains(query, true) }) { p ->
                    QuickCard(p.title, Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { detail = "learn:${p.id}" }
                }
                item { TextButton({ openEngineering("home") }) { Text(if (access.unlocked) "Engineering bookmarks" else "Unlock engineering bookmarks") } }
                item { SectionTitle("Saved calculations") }
                if (prefs.calculations.isEmpty()) item { Text("Save a result from a calculator's menu. Inputs are retained automatically.") }
                items(prefs.calculations.filter { it.contains(query, true) }) { result ->
                    Card { Text(result, Modifier.padding(16.dp)); TextButton({ share(context, result) }) { Text("Share calculation") } }
                }
            }
            else -> ElectroSettings(vm, prefs, body)
        }
    }
}

/** Shared section typography gives catalogue and dashboard a consistent visual hierarchy.
 * @param title Visible section heading.
 * @return Unit; displays a heading without modifying state.
 */
@Composable
private fun SectionTitle(title: String) { Text(title, Modifier.padding(vertical = 8.dp), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }

/** Native action card; it remains usable with large font sizes instead of using a fixed height.
 * @param title Accessible card caption.
 * @param modifier Caller-owned size and spacing.
 * @param click Explicit navigation or action callback.
 * @return Unit; activates the callback only on user selection.
 */
@Composable
private fun QuickCard(title: String, modifier: Modifier, click: () -> Unit) {
    Card(onClick = click, modifier = modifier, shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp)) {
        Text(title, Modifier.padding(20.dp), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
    }
}

/** Existing DataStore owns appearance, favorites and calculator history; clearing requires confirmation.
 * @param vm Existing DataStore mutation owner.
 * @param prefs Current committed appearance and history state.
 * @param modifier Host-provided insets and layout bounds.
 * @return Unit; destructive history clearing requires the displayed confirmation.
 */
@Composable
fun ElectroSettings(vm: AppViewModel, prefs: PreferencesState, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    var confirm by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    Column(modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(20.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
        SectionTitle("Make it your workbench")
        Text("Appearance", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Text("Light theme", Modifier.weight(1f))
            Switch(prefs.light, { vm.theme(it) })
        }
        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            listOf("dark", "light", "system").forEach { mode -> FilterChip((prefs.themeMode.ifBlank { if (prefs.light) "light" else "dark" }) == mode,
                { vm.appearance(mode) }, label = { Text(mode.replaceFirstChar { it.uppercase() }) }) }
        }
        HorizontalDivider()
        Text("Language: English")
        Text("Offline by design", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
        Text("No accounts, analytics, ads or network permission. Favorites, settings, inputs and saved results stay on this device. Android sharing sends only the text you choose to share.")
        Text("Engineering access is a basic local restriction. References are bundled, not encrypted.")
        TextButton({ confirm = true }) { Text("Clear saved calculation history") }
        TextButton({ vm.sort() }) { Text(if (prefs.alphabetical) "Use original tool order" else "Sort tools A–Z") }
        HorizontalDivider()
        Text("ELECTRO ${BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME} (${BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE})", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
        Text("Electrical • Electronics • Engineering\nAndroid 7.0+ • Native Kotlin & Jetpack Compose")
        Text("Component artwork is illustrative. Confirm exact parts, ratings and wiring against the original manufacturer documentation.")
    }
    if (confirm) AlertDialog(onDismissRequest = { confirm = false }, title = { Text("Clear saved results?") }, text = { Text("Your favorites and calculator inputs will be retained.") },
        confirmButton = { TextButton({ vm.clearCalculations(); confirm = false }) { Text("Clear history") } },
        dismissButton = { TextButton({ confirm = false }) { Text("Cancel") } })
}

/** Component pages distinguish generic educational material from unverified part-specific information.
 * @param asset Selected local illustrative image.
 * @param prefs Current favorite keys.
 * @param vm Existing favorite-persistence owner.
 * @param back Returns to the preceding library screen.
 * @return Unit; all part-specific ratings remain explicitly unverified.
 */
@Composable
private fun ComponentDetail(asset: ComponentAsset, prefs: PreferencesState, vm: AppViewModel, back: () -> Unit) {
    val id = "component:${asset.id}"
    Scaffold(topBar = { Bar(asset.name, back) { IconButton({ vm.star(id) }) { Icon(painterResource(if (id in prefs.favourites) R.drawable.ic_star_filled else R.drawable.ic_star_outline), "Favorite component") } } }) { padding ->
        LazyColumn(Modifier.padding(padding), contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
            item { ComponentImage(asset, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(max = 420.dp).aspectRatio(1f).clip(RoundedCornerShape(24.dp)), detail = true) }
            item { Text(asset.category.uppercase(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium); SectionTitle(asset.name) }
            val info = componentNotes(asset)
            items(info) { (title, body) -> Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { Column(Modifier.padding(16.dp)) { Text(title, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium); Text(body, Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp)) } } }
        }
    }
}

/** Generic operating principles do not assign a manufacturer rating or terminal layout to artwork.
 * @param asset Component family inferred from its supplied descriptive filename.
 * @return Generic educational sections, without invented manufacturer ratings or contact assignments.
 */
private fun componentNotes(asset: ComponentAsset): List<Pair<String, String>> {
    val principle = when {
        "resistor" in asset.id -> "A resistor opposes current: V = I × R for an ohmic element. Power is dissipated as heat. Value, tolerance, temperature coefficient and power rating depend on the actual part."
        "capacitor" in asset.id -> "A capacitor stores energy in an electric field. Capacitance, working voltage, polarity, leakage and ESR depend on construction and the exact part. Stored charge may remain after disconnection."
        "inductor" in asset.id -> "An inductor stores energy in a magnetic field and opposes changes in current. Saturation current, winding resistance and insulation limits must come from its datasheet."
        "diode" in asset.id || asset.id == "led" || "rectifier" in asset.id -> "A semiconductor junction conducts asymmetrically. Rectifier, Zener and light-emitting parts have different operating requirements. Verify polarity, current limits and reverse-voltage limits for the specific device."
        "motor" in asset.id -> "An electric motor converts electrical energy into mechanical motion. Induction, DC and geared assemblies differ in supply, starting, control and protection. The nameplate and original manual define the applicable limits."
        "relay" in asset.id || "contactor" in asset.id -> "A control signal operates a switching mechanism. Coil supply and contact load are separate ratings. Contact arrangements and overload/reset behavior vary; verify the exact circuit diagram."
        "sensor" in asset.id || "probe" in asset.id || "switch" in asset.id || "encoder" in asset.id -> "The device detects a physical state or position and produces a contact or electrical output. Detection range, output type, polarity, supply and environmental rating depend on the exact model."
        "transformer" in asset.id -> "Magnetically coupled windings transfer AC energy. Primary/secondary ratings, insulation, earthing and protective devices are determined by the original design; a photograph cannot establish them."
        "mcb" in asset.id || "mccb" in asset.id -> "A circuit breaker interrupts specified overcurrent conditions. Rated current, trip curve, interrupting capacity and installation conditions must match the circuit design. It is not a substitute for all forms of shock protection."
        else -> "This illustration identifies the general component family. Electrical behavior, compatible interfaces, terminal arrangement and operating limits require the exact part number and original technical documentation."
    }
    return listOf("Description & operating principle" to principle,
        "Applications" to "Use this ${asset.category.lowercase()} reference for visual identification and learning. Select a real part only after checking the circuit requirements, environmental conditions and approved documentation.",
        "Specifications" to "No manufacturer-specific ratings have been verified for this generated illustration. Do not infer a voltage, current, safety rating or model from its appearance.",
        "Symbol, terminals & connection" to "Use the exact device's schematic symbol and numbered terminal drawing. Generated markings and connector geometry are not wiring authority. Consult the Tools → Pin-outs references and Learn → Lessons for generic interface concepts.",
        "Testing procedure" to "1. Identify the exact part. 2. Isolate all energy sources and verify the safe state. 3. Follow the manufacturer's test method with a correctly rated instrument. 4. Compare results with documented limits. This page does not authorize live testing.",
        "Troubleshooting" to "Record the symptom and actual model. Inspect for damage only in a safe isolated state. Check documented connections and supply conditions. Do not bypass interlocks or replace a part solely because it resembles this image.",
        "Safety & provenance" to "User-supplied AI-generated artwork, optimized for visual learning rather than product verification. Never rely on it for exact geometry or terminal markings. Escalator work requires qualified personnel and the equipment's approved procedures.")
}

/** Scrollable, bookmarkable lessons use authored text rather than embedding instruction screenshots.
 * @param page Authored educational content and citation URLs.
 * @param prefs Current lesson bookmarks.
 * @param vm Existing bookmark-persistence owner.
 * @param back Returns to the lesson catalogue.
 * @return Unit; citations are shared only after explicit user action.
 */
@Composable
private fun LearningDetail(page: LearningPage, prefs: PreferencesState, vm: AppViewModel, back: () -> Unit) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val id = "learn:${page.id}"
    Scaffold(topBar = { Bar(page.title, back) { IconButton({ vm.star(id) }) { Icon(painterResource(if (id in prefs.favourites) R.drawable.ic_star_filled else R.drawable.ic_star_outline), "Favorite lesson") } } }) { padding ->
        LazyColumn(Modifier.padding(padding), contentPadding = PaddingValues(20.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
            item { Text("LEARN • OFFLINE REFERENCE", color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium) }
            if (page.id == "multimeter") item { MultimeterLesson() }
            items(page.sections) { (title, body) -> Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { Column(Modifier.padding(20.dp)) { SectionTitle(title); Text(body) } } }
            item { SectionTitle("Original technical references"); Text("Links are reference citations stored offline. Use current manufacturer documentation for real equipment.") }
            items(page.sources) { source -> Text(source); TextButton({ share(context, source) }) { Text("Share reference link") } }
        }
    }
}
````

## app/src/main/java/com/electrokit/app/viewmodel/AppViewModel.kt

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.viewmodel

import android.app.Application
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.electrokit.app.R
import com.electrokit.app.data.AppRepository
import com.electrokit.app.data.PreferencesState
import com.electrokit.app.data.Repository
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancelAndJoin
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/**
 * Coordinates asset loading, atomic preference mutations and unsaved input snapshots across
 * Activity recreation.
 *
 * @param application Application context used for lifecycle-independent local storage.
 * @param repository Injectable storage boundary; production uses the bundled asset/DataStore
 *   repository. Initialisation starts asynchronous loading; recoverable failures are exposed
 *   through error state.
 */
class AppViewModel
@JvmOverloads
constructor(
    application: Application,
    /** Injectable storage boundary; production uses the bundled asset/DataStore repository. */
    val repository: AppRepository = Repository(application),
    /** Disk worker; tests may inject a controlled dispatcher without changing production threading. */
    private val ioDispatcher: kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineDispatcher = Dispatchers.IO,
) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    /** Latest preference snapshot overlaid with uncommitted edits. */
    private val state = MutableStateFlow(PreferencesState())
    /** Preference observation owned by storage and exposed read-only by the ViewModel. */
    val preferences = state.asStateFlow()
    /** Successful initial asset/preference loading state. */
    private val loadingComplete = MutableStateFlow(false)
    /** Read-only initialisation status for the loading UI. */
    val loaded = loadingComplete.asStateFlow()
    /** Recoverable operation error; raw exception details are not displayed. */
    private val errors = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    /** Read-only banner text for the current recoverable storage failure. */
    val error = errors.asStateFlow()
    /** Exact failed operation, retained until retry or dismissal. */
    private var retryAction: (() -> Unit)? = null
    /** Asset/preference subscription cancelled before restarting loading. */
    private var loading: Job? = null
    /** Main-record input job; the durable journal already protects its pending values. */
    private var saveJob: Job? = null
    /** Serializes commits so an older disk transaction cannot overwrite newer typing. */
    private val inputMutex = Mutex()
    /** Identifies the visible failure; unrelated successful operations cannot dismiss it. */
    private var errorKind: String? = null
    /**
     * Latest unsaved snapshots, owned on the ViewModel main thread. Main-thread snapshots overlay
     * disk emissions, so an older record cannot undo new typing.
     */
    private val pending = mutableMapOf<String, Map<String, String>>()

    init {
        retryLoading()
    }

    /**
     * Restarts the asset/preference subscription so a transient read failure can recover without
     * restarting the app.
     *
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    fun retryLoading() {
        loading?.cancel()
        errors.value = null
        loading =
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    repository.loadAssets()
                    withContext(ioDispatcher) { repository.stagedInputs() }.forEach { (id, values) ->
                        if (id !in pending) pending[id] = values
                    }
                    if (pending.isNotEmpty()) flushInputs()
                    repository.preferences.collect {
                        state.value = it.copy(values = it.values + pending)
                        loadingComplete.value = true
                    }
                } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                    throw e
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    retryAction = ::retryLoading
                    errorKind = "load"
                errors.value = getApplication<Application>().getString(R.string.error_load)
                }
            }
    }

    /**
     * Transforms the latest preference record atomically; the ViewModel wrapper retains the exact
     * failed mutation for Retry.
     *
     * @param transform Atomic transformation of the latest persisted snapshot.
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    private fun update(transform: (PreferencesState) -> PreferencesState) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                repository.update(transform)
                if (errorKind == "settings") { errors.value = null; retryAction = null; errorKind = null }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                retryAction = { update(transform) }
                errorKind = "settings"
                errors.value = getApplication<Application>().getString(R.string.error_settings)
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Replays the operation associated with the visible error instead of flushing unrelated input
     * fields.
     *
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    fun retryFailedAction() {
        retryAction?.invoke()
    }

    /**
     * Clears both the banner and its retained action so a dismissed operation cannot be replayed
     * accidentally.
     *
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    fun dismissError() {
        retryAction = null
        errors.value = null
    }

    /**
     * Explicitly clears saved state; the ViewModel cancels pending input work before reloading
     * defaults.
     *
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    fun resetPreferences() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                // Wait for an in-flight fsync before resetting, or old data could reappear.
                saveJob?.cancelAndJoin()
                pending.clear()
                inputMutex.withLock { withContext(ioDispatcher) { repository.resetPreferences() } }
                retryLoading()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (e is CancellationException) throw e
                retryAction = ::resetPreferences
                errorKind = "reset"
                errors.value = getApplication<Application>().getString(R.string.error_reset)
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Persists an explicit palette selection rather than toggling an unobserved transient UI flag.
     *
     * @param light True selects the light palette.
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    fun theme(light: Boolean) = update { it.copy(light = light, themeMode = if (light) "light" else "dark") }

    /** Persists appearance while retaining the legacy Boolean for older installation data.
 * @param mode One of dark, light or system.
 * @return Unit; persistence errors surface through the shared error state.
 */
    fun appearance(mode: String) = update { it.copy(themeMode = mode, light = mode == "light") }

    /** Records public navigation only; bounds the persistent list to twenty stable IDs.
 * @param id Public registry identifier, excluding protected controller details.
 * @return Unit; records at most twenty most-recent distinct routes.
 */
    fun visited(id: String) = update { it.copy(recent = (listOf(id) + it.recent.filterNot { old -> old == id }).take(20)) }

    /** Saves an explicit calculation snapshot without changing the existing raw-input journal.
 * @param text Explicitly saved public calculator result, inputs and model.
 * @return Unit; retains at most fifty snapshots in existing storage.
 */
    fun saveCalculation(text: String) = update { it.copy(calculations = (listOf(text) + it.calculations).take(50)) }

    /** Clears explicit result history only; raw calculator input and favourites are retained.
 * @return Unit; clears result history after UI confirmation, retaining raw inputs and favorites.
 */
    fun clearCalculations() = update { it.copy(calculations = emptyList()) }

    /**
     * Toggles catalogue order inside the atomic preference transformation.
     *
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    fun sort() = update { it.copy(alphabetical = !it.alphabetical) }

    /**
     * Toggles a favourite by stable registry ID so title changes do not lose the saved selection.
     *
     * @param id Stable calculator or registry identifier; independent of the visible title.
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    fun star(id: String) = update {
        it.copy(favourites = if (id in it.favourites) it.favourites - id else it.favourites + id)
    }

    /**
     * Persists the selected calculator mode separately from its raw field snapshot.
     *
     * @param id Stable calculator or registry identifier; independent of the visible title.
     * @param mode Calculator mode index retained independently of raw scalar inputs.
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    fun mode(id: String, mode: Int) = update { it.copy(modes = it.modes + (id to mode)) }

    /**
     * Updates visible input immediately and queues an atomic backup on Dispatchers.IO.
     * Abrupt process termination before the worker commits can lose the latest edit.
     *
     * @param id Stable calculator or registry identifier; independent of the visible title.
     * @param values Caller-owned field/component snapshot; not mutated by this operation.
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    fun values(id: String, values: Map<String, String>) {
        pending[id] = values.toMap()
        state.value = state.value.copy(values = state.value.values + (id to values.toMap()))
        // One worker drains the latest map; keystrokes never block on flash or cancel an fsync.
        if (saveJob?.isActive != true) saveJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            inputMutex.withLock { persistInputs() }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Schedules a pending main-record write before lifecycle stop or an explicit save retry.
     *
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    fun flushInputs() {
        if (saveJob?.isActive != true) saveJob = viewModelScope.launch { inputMutex.withLock { persistInputs() } }
    }

    /**
     * Commits a snapshot and removes only unchanged pending entries so newer edits cannot be
     * discarded by an older write.
     *
     * @return Unit; rendering effects and state changes are delivered through callbacks or
     *   observable state. Recoverable storage failures are exposed through error state;
     *   cancellation is rethrown.
     */
    private suspend fun persistInputs() {
        while (pending.isNotEmpty()) {
        val snapshot = pending.toMap()
        try {
            withContext(ioDispatcher) {
                snapshot.forEach { (id, values) -> repository.stageInputs(id, values) }
                repository.update { it.copy(values = it.values + snapshot) }
                repository.clearStagedInputs(snapshot)
            }
            // Remove only unchanged entries: edits made during this write must remain pending.
            snapshot.forEach { (id, values) -> if (pending[id] == values) pending.remove(id) }
            if (errorKind == "inputs") { errors.value = null; retryAction = null; errorKind = null }
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            retryAction = ::flushInputs
            errorKind = "inputs"
                errors.value = getApplication<Application>().getString(R.string.error_inputs)
            return
        }
        }
    }
}
````

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.viewmodel

import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import com.electrokit.app.domain.LocalPin

/** Activity-session access state: survives rotation, never persists across process recreation. */
class EngineeringAccess : ViewModel() {
    /** Observable grant for this activity ViewModel only; never saved or restored. */
    var unlocked by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set
    /** Rejected attempts since the last cooldown or successful verification. */
    private var failures = 0
    /** Monotonic retry deadline; wall-clock changes cannot bypass the delay. */
    private var retryAt = 0L
    /** Overlapping navigation animations may compose multiple gates against the same Activity. */
    private var protectedSurfaces = 0

    /** Marks a protected surface without retaining its Window in the ViewModel.
     * @param window Current Activity window, used only for this call.
     * @return Unit; secure previews remain enabled until all overlapping gates leave.
     */
    fun enterProtected(window: android.view.Window) {
        protectedSurfaces++
        window.addFlags(android.view.WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE)
    }

    /** Releases one gate after navigation or lifecycle disposal.
     * @param window Window belonging to the disposed gate.
     * @return Unit; the last active gate restores ordinary window behavior.
     */
    fun leaveProtected(window: android.view.Window) {
        protectedSurfaces = (protectedSurfaces - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
        if (protectedSurfaces == 0) window.clearFlags(android.view.WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE)
    }

    /** Rate-limits failed attempts in memory; returns a user-facing outcome without echoing input.
 * @param candidate Entered code, never copied into persistent state or error messages.
 * @return Null on success; otherwise a user-facing rejection or temporary rate-limit message.
 */
    fun unlock(candidate: String): String? {
        if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < retryAt) return "Too many attempts. Wait 30 seconds."
        if (LocalPin.verify(candidate)) {
            unlocked = true
            failures = 0
            return null
        }
        failures++
        if (failures >= 5) {
            retryAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 30_000
            failures = 0
        }
        return "Access code not accepted."
    }

    /** Immediately removes protected content from every composable sharing this session.
 * @return Unit; synchronously removes access for all destinations sharing this ViewModel.
 */
    fun lock() { unlocked = false }
}

````

## app/src/main/java/com/electrokit/app/viewmodel/EngineeringViewModel.kt

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.viewmodel

import android.app.Application
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.electrokit.app.data.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.*
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/**
 * Loads the immutable engineering assets off the UI thread while preserving legacy storage.
 *
 * @param application Application-owned asset access; no Activity is retained. Asset failures become
 *   a retryable error state; cancellation is never swallowed.
 */
class EngineeringViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    /** Atomic complete corpus; null until both datasets are validated. */
    private val mutableContent =
        MutableStateFlow<Pair<EngineeringContent, List<EngineeringTool>>?>(null)
    /** Read-only complete content, preventing partially loaded cross-reference links. */
    val content = mutableContent.asStateFlow()
    /** True when asset parsing or structural validation failed. */
    private val mutableFailed = MutableStateFlow(false)
    /** UI uses a resource message rather than exposing parser exception details. */
    val failed = mutableFailed.asStateFlow()
    /** A single load job prevents competing retries publishing inconsistent snapshots. */
    private var job: Job? = null

    init {
        reload()
    }

    /**
     * Retries reading and validating the local engineering datasets.
     *
     * @return Unit; I/O/serialization failures set failed, cancellation propagates.
     */
    fun reload() {
        job?.cancel()
        mutableFailed.value = false
        job =
            viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                try {
                    val assets = getApplication<Application>().assets
                    val corpus =
                        assets.open("engineering.json").bufferedReader().use {
                            Json.decodeFromString<EngineeringContent>(it.readText())
                        }
                    val tools =
                        assets.open("engineering_tools.json").bufferedReader().use {
                            Json.decodeFromString<List<EngineeringTool>>(it.readText())
                        }
                    require(
                        corpus.faults.isNotEmpty() &&
                            corpus.faults.map { it.code }.distinct().size == corpus.faults.size
                    )
                    val ids = corpus.records.map { it.id }.toSet()
                    val sources = corpus.sources.map { it.id }.toSet()
                    require(
                        ids.size == corpus.records.size &&
                            tools.map { it.id }.distinct().size == tools.size
                    )
                    require(
                        corpus.records.all {
                            sources.containsAll(it.sources) && ids.containsAll(it.related)
                        }
                    )
                    require(
                        corpus.faults.all {
                            sources.containsAll(it.sources) && ids.containsAll(it.related)
                        }
                    )
                    mutableContent.value = corpus to tools
                } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
                    throw cancelled
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    mutableFailed.value = true
                }
            }
    }
}

````

## app/src/test/java/com/electrokit/app/data/DataRegressionTests.kt

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.data

import java.io.File
import java.io.IOException
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * Groups regression assertions for data regression tests; unexpected behaviour fails the test
 * visibly.
 */
class DataRegressionTests {
    /**
     * Verifies saved values modes and preferences round trip; unexpected behaviour fails the test
     * visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun savedValuesModesAndPreferencesRoundTrip() {
        val state =
            PreferencesState(
                light = true,
                alphabetical = true,
                favourites = setOf("c8", "p1"),
                modules = setOf("m1"),
                values = mapOf("c8" to mapOf("ratio" to "1e9", "unit_base" to "3")),
                modes = mapOf("c8" to 2),
            )
        assertEquals(state, PreferenceCodec.decode(PreferenceCodec.encode(state)))
    }

    /**
     * Verifies original state records remain compatible; unexpected behaviour fails the test
     * visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun originalStateRecordsRemainCompatible() {
        assertEquals(PreferencesState(), PreferenceCodec.decode(null))
        assertEquals(
            PreferencesState(light = true),
            PreferenceCodec.decode("""{"light":true,"futureField":10}"""),
        )
    }

    /**
     * Verifies damaged state is not silently replaced; unexpected behaviour fails the test visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test(expected = IOException::class)
    fun damagedStateIsNotSilentlyReplaced() {
        PreferenceCodec.decode("{damaged")
    }

    /**
     * Verifies bundled assets decode with shipping kotlin models; unexpected behaviour fails the
     * test visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun bundledAssetsDecodeWithShippingKotlinModels() {
        val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }
        val assets = File("src/main/assets")
        assertTrue("Unit-test working directory must be the app module", assets.isDirectory)
        val registry = json.decodeFromString<List<Entry>>(File(assets, "registry.json").readText())
        val pages = json.decodeFromString<Map<String, Page>>(File(assets, "pages.json").readText())
        val modules =
            json.decodeFromString<Map<String, List<Part>>>(File(assets, "modules.json").readText())
        assertEquals(110, registry.size)
        assertEquals(72, pages.size)
        assertEquals(setOf("m1", "m2", "m3"), modules.keys)
        assertTrue(modules.values.all { it.size >= 30 })
        assertTrue(modules.getValue("m1").all { "Description" !in it.numericKeys })
        assertTrue(modules.getValue("m3").all { "Instruction word bits" in it.numericKeys })
    }

    /**
     * Verifies numeric memory fields have specific datasheet references; unexpected behaviour fails
     * the test visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun numericMemoryFieldsHaveSpecificDatasheetReferences() {
        val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }
        val modules =
            json.decodeFromString<Map<String, List<Part>>>(
                File("src/main/assets/modules.json").readText()
            )
        assertTrue(modules.getValue("m1").all { java.net.URI(it.source).path.length > 1 })
        val memory = modules.getValue("m3").filter { "Program memory words" in it.numericKeys }
        assertEquals(8, memory.size)
        assertTrue(
            memory.all {
                it.specs.getValue("Memory reference").startsWith("https://ww1.microchip.com/")
            }
        )
        assertEquals("256", memory.first { it.name == "PIC10F200" }.specs["Program memory words"])
        assertEquals("41", memory.first { it.name == "PIC12F509" }.specs["SRAM bytes"])
    }

    /**
     * Every technical page must expose its recorded provenance, including an explicit unverified
     * status.
     *
     * @return Unit; missing status text fails without treating citation URLs as proof of accuracy.
     */
    @Test
    fun referenceProvenanceIsExplicitOnEveryPage() {
        val pages =
            Json.decodeFromString<Map<String, Page>>(File("src/main/assets/pages.json").readText())
        assertEquals(72, pages.size)
        assertTrue(pages.values.all { it.provenance.isNotBlank() })
        assertTrue(
            pages.values
                .filter { it.sources.isEmpty() }
                .all { it.provenance.contains("not independently verified") }
        )
    }
}
````

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.domain

import kotlin.math.pow
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * Groups regression assertions for audit regression tests; unexpected behaviour fails the test
 * visibly.
 */
class AuditRegressionTests {
    /**
     * Derives fixtures from the shipping specification instead of duplicating a stale default-input
     * table.
     *
     * @param id Stable calculator or registry identifier; independent of the visible title.
     * @return Default field values derived from the shipping calculator specification.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    private fun defaults(id: Int) = Calculators.spec(id).fields.associate { it.key to it.initial }

    /**
     * Verifies extreme ratios return errors without throwing; unexpected behaviour fails the test
     * visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun extremeRatiosReturnErrorsWithoutThrowing() {
        for (ratio in listOf("1e-309", "1e-9", "1e-8", "1e8", "1e9", "1e308")) {
            for (mode in 0..2) {
                val result = Calculators.calculate(8, defaults(8) + ("ratio" to ratio), mode)
                assertTrue("$ratio/$mode: ${result.text}", result is Calculation.Error)
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Verifies supported ratio boundaries find pairs; unexpected behaviour fails the test visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun supportedRatioBoundariesFindPairs() {
        for (ratio in listOf("1e-7", "1", "1e7")) {
            val result = Calculators.calculate(8, defaults(8) + ("ratio" to ratio), 2)
            assertTrue(result.text, result is Calculation.Value)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Verifies explicit suffix overrides every selector; unexpected behaviour fails the test
     * visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun explicitSuffixOverridesEverySelector() {
        for (exp in listOf(-12, -9, -6, -3, 0, 3, 6, 9)) {
            assertEquals(10000.0, Engineering.input("10k", exp)!!, 0.0)
            assertEquals(4700.0, Engineering.input("4k7", exp)!!, 0.0)
            assertEquals(12.0, Engineering.input("12V", exp)!!, 0.0)
            assertEquals(10.0 * 10.0.pow(exp), Engineering.input("10", exp)!!, 0.0)

    /**

    fun explicitUnitsAreConvertedToTheFieldUnit() {

        assertEquals(2.0, Engineering.input("2000W", 0, "kW")!!, 0.0)
        assertNull(Engineering.input("12V", 0, "A"))
    }

    /**

        assertEquals(expected, Resistors.tolerance.values.map(Engineering::percent))
        for (x in Resistors.tolerance.values) assertEquals(
            Engineering.percent(x),
            Engineering.format(x, "%"),
        )

    /**

    fun invalidPersistedModesAreClamped() {

            val value = Calculators.calculate(id, defaults(id), mode)

    @Test
    fun inactiveOpAmpInputsCanBeEmpty() {
        for (mode in 0..1) assertTrue(
            Calculators.calculate(12, defaults(12) + mapOf("v2" to "", "r3" to ""), mode)
                is Calculation.Value
        )
        assertTrue(Calculators.calculate(12, defaults(12) + ("r3" to ""), 3) is Calculation.Value)
        assertTrue(Calculators.calculate(12, defaults(12) + ("r3" to ""), 2) is Calculation.Error)
    }

    /**
     * Verifies rounding normalises engineering prefixes; unexpected behaviour fails the test
     * visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun roundingNormalisesEngineeringPrefixes() {
        assertEquals("1 MΩ", Engineering.format(999999.9, "Ω"))
        assertEquals("1 V", Engineering.format(.9999999, "V"))
        assertFalse(Engineering.format(1e-18, "F").contains(" p"))
        assertEquals("4095", Engineering.decimal(4095.0))
    }

    /**
     * Verifies negative module values filter correctly; unexpected behaviour fails the test
     * visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun negativeModuleValuesFilterCorrectly() {
        assertTrue(NumericFilter.matches("−5", "-12", "0"))
        assertFalse(NumericFilter.matches("5", "-12", "0"))
        assertFalse(NumericFilter.matches("−12", "-10", "0"))
        assertFalse(NumericFilter.matches("5", "bad", ""))
        assertNotNull(NumericFilter.validation("10", "-10"))
        assertNotNull(NumericFilter.validation("", "bad"))
    }

    /**
     * Verifies extreme input grid never crashes or leaks requirement text; unexpected behaviour
     * fails the test visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun extremeInputGridNeverCrashesOrLeaksRequirementText() {
        val samples = listOf("", "garbage", "abc", "NaN", "-1", "0", "1e-300", "1e300")
        var exercised = 0
        for (id in 1..31) {
            val spec = Calculators.spec(id)
            for (mode in spec.modes.indices) for (field in spec.fields) for (input in samples) {
                exercised++
                val result = Calculators.calculate(id, defaults(id) + (field.key to input), mode)
                assertTrue("$id/${field.key}/$input", result.text.isNotBlank())
                assertFalse(
                    "$id/$mode/${field.key}/$input: ${result.text}",
                    result.text.contains("Failed requirement.") ||
                        result.text == "Check the input values and selected mode." ||
                        result.text.contains("NaN") ||
                        result.text.contains("Infinity"),
                )
            }
        }
        println("Extreme per-field cases exercised: $exercised")
    }

    /**
     * Verifies field errors name their inputs; unexpected behaviour fails the test visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun fieldErrorsNameTheirInputs() {
        val negativeTime = Calculators.calculate(11, defaults(11) + ("t" to "-1"))
        assertTrue(negativeTime is Calculation.Error)
        assertTrue(negativeTime.text.contains("Elapsed time"))
        val invalidCode = Calculators.calculate(2, defaults(2) + ("code" to "00A"))
        assertTrue(invalidCode.text.contains("01 to 96"))
    }
}
````

````kotlin
            Calculators.calculate(
                    30,
                    mapOf("x" to "12", "a" to "4", "b" to "20", "c" to "0", "d" to "100"),
                )
                .text
        assertTrue(out.contains("50"))
    }
}
````

## app/src/test/java/com/electrokit/app/domain/EngineeringModuleTests.kt

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.domain

import com.electrokit.app.data.*
import java.io.File
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * Independently specified engineering, source-integrity and search regression checks; no Android
 * runtime.
 */
class EngineeringModuleTests {
    /** Complete immutable bundled corpus used by integrity and filter assertions. */
    private val data =
        Json.decodeFromString<EngineeringContent>(
            File("src/main/assets/engineering.json").readText()
        )
    /** New-tool definitions allow systematic field/edge-case coverage. */
    private val tools =
        Json.decodeFromString<List<EngineeringTool>>(
            File("src/main/assets/engineering_tools.json").readText()
        )

    /**
     * Requires the exact supplied serial/code/message/reset/group columns, including gaps and
     * strings.
     *
     * @return Unit; any altered original field fails the assertion.
     */
    @Test
    fun exact125RowImport() {
        val rows =
            javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/faults-original.tsv")!!.bufferedReader().readLines()
        assertEquals(125, data.faults.size)
        assertEquals(
            rows,
            data.faults.map { "${it.serial}|${it.code}|${it.message}|${it.reset}|${it.group}" },
        )
        assertEquals((1..128).filterNot { it in 112..114 }, data.faults.map { it.serial })
        assertEquals("Need maintenance", data.faults.single { it.code == "164" }.message)
        assertEquals(125, data.faults.map { it.code }.toSet().size)
    }

    /**
     * Proves every relation, section, source and interactive marker resolves without invented
     * targets.
     *
     * @return Unit; broken references or lost photographed sources fail.
     */
    @Test
    fun graphAndSourceIntegrity() {
        val ids = data.records.map { it.id }.toSet()
        val sources = data.sources.map { it.id }.toSet()
        assertEquals(data.records.size, ids.size)
        assertEquals(14, data.sources.count { it.type == "Photograph transcription" })
        assertEquals(13, data.sections.size)
        data.records.forEach { r ->
            assertTrue(sources.containsAll(r.sources))
            assertTrue(ids.containsAll(r.related))
            assertTrue(data.sections.any { it.id == r.section })
        }
        data.faults.forEach {
            assertTrue(ids.containsAll(it.related))
            assertTrue(sources.containsAll(it.sources))
        }
        data.markers.forEach {
            assertTrue(it.record in ids)
            assertTrue(it.source in sources)
            assertTrue(it.x in 0f..1000f && it.y in 0f..560f)
        }
        assertTrue(data.records.single { it.id == "output-Q9–Q12" }.summary.contains("grouped"))
        assertFalse(
            data.records.any {
                it.id in listOf("output-Q9", "output-Q10", "output-Q11", "output-Q12")
            }
        )
        assertTrue(data.records.single { it.id == "input-I10" }.title.contains("Not Verified"))
    }

    /**
     * Exercises code/message matching and intersected group/reset/bookmark filters.
     *
     * @return Unit; mismatched classifications or a lost exact code fail.
     */
    @Test
    fun searchAndFilters() {
        assertEquals(listOf("E217"), EngineeringSearch.faults(data.faults, "e217").map { it.code })
        assertEquals(
            listOf("164"),
            EngineeringSearch.faults(data.faults, " Need maintenance ").map { it.code },
        )
        assertTrue(
            EngineeringSearch.faults(data.faults, "", "CBM Alarm", "Auto").all {
                it.group == "CBM Alarm" && it.reset == "Auto"
            }
        )
        assertEquals(
            listOf("E001"),
            EngineeringSearch.faults(data.faults, "", bookmarks = setOf("E001")).map { it.code },
        )
        assertTrue(EngineeringSearch.faults(data.faults, "abc-not-a-fault").isEmpty())
        assertEquals(125, EngineeringSearch.faults(data.faults, "").size)
    }

    /**
     * Checks a new tool result using explicit scalar inputs and an independently specified result
     * fragment.
     *
     * @param id Calculator identifier.
     * @param values Finite physical field values.
     * @param expected Independent reference text/value after six-digit display rounding.
     * @return Unit; domain errors or incorrect results fail.
     */
    private fun check(id: String, values: Map<String, String>, expected: String) {
        val result = EngineeringTools.calculate(id, values)
        assertTrue(result.text, result is Calculation.Value)
        assertTrue(result.text, result.text.contains(expected))
    }

    /** @return Unit; validates √3×400×10×0.8 against 5.54256 kW independently. */
    @Test
    fun balancedThreePhase() {
        check("three-phase", mapOf("v" to "400", "i" to "10", "pf" to "0.8"), "5.54256 kW")
    }

    /** @return Unit; validates 230×10×0.9 = 2.07 kW independently. */
    @Test
    fun singlePhase() {
        check("single-phase", mapOf("v" to "230", "i" to "10", "pf" to "0.9"), "2.07 kW")
    }

    /** @return Unit; validates 15 kW shaft-current estimate with explicit PF and efficiency. */
    @Test
    fun motorCurrent() {
        check(
            "motor-current",
            mapOf("p" to "15", "v" to "415", "pf" to "0.76", "eta" to "91.2"),
            "30.1075 A",
        )
    }

    /** @return Unit; independently checks 15/16.5 output/input efficiency. */
    @Test
    fun efficiency() {
        check("efficiency", mapOf("out" to "15", "in" to "16.5"), "90.91%")
    }

    /** @return Unit; checks unitful kVA input and dimensionless 0.8 power factor. */
    @Test
    fun powerFactor() {
        check("power-factor", mapOf("p" to "8kW", "s" to "10kVA"), "0.8")
    }

    /** @return Unit; validates 15 kW at 975 rpm against the exact torque relationship. */
    @Test
    fun torque() {
        check("torque", mapOf("p" to "15", "n" to "975"), "146.912 N·m")
    }

    /** @return Unit; checks explicit six poles → 1000 rpm and 2.5% slip. */
    @Test
    fun slip() {
        check("slip", mapOf("f" to "50", "poles" to "6", "n" to "975"), "2.5%")
    }

    /** @return Unit; checks explicit slip yields 975 rpm. */
    @Test
    fun frequencySpeed() {
        check("frequency-speed", mapOf("f" to "50", "poles" to "6", "slip" to "2.5"), "975 rpm")
    }

    /** @return Unit; ideal 0.5 m/s, 0.4 m pitch, one person/step gives 4500 persons/h. */
    @Test
    fun theoreticalCapacity() {
        check(
            "capacity",
            mapOf("v" to "0.5m/s", "pitch" to "0.4m", "occupancy" to "1"),
            "4500 persons/h",
        )
    }

    /** @return Unit; tests explicitly supplied gear reduction and chain geometry. */
    @Test
    fun gearAndStepSpeed() {
        check("gear-ratio", mapOf("input" to "975", "output" to "32.5"), "Reduction ratio: 30")
        check("gear", mapOf("n" to "975", "ratio" to "30"), "32.5 rpm")
        check(
            "step-speed",
            mapOf("n" to "975", "ratio" to "30", "teeth" to "20", "pitch" to "0.05"),
            "0.541667 m/s",
        )
    }

    /** @return Unit; validates 5 kW×8 h = 40 kWh and 10 m at 30° gives 5 m rise. */
    @Test
    fun energyAndGeometry() {
        check("energy", mapOf("p" to "5", "h" to "8h"), "40 kWh")
        check("geometry", mapOf("length" to "10", "angle" to "30°"), "5 m")
    }

    /** @return Unit; verifies exact conversion factors and rejects dimensionally wrong values. */
    @Test
    fun unitConversions() {
        check("unit-converter", mapOf("conversion" to "mA → A", "x" to "20mA"), "0.02 A")
        check("unit-converter", mapOf("conversion" to "kWh → J", "x" to "1kWh"), "3.6E+6 J")
        assertTrue(
            EngineeringTools.calculate(
                "unit-converter",
                mapOf("conversion" to "W → kW", "x" to "10V"),
            ) is Calculation.Error
        )
        assertTrue(
            EngineeringTools.calculate(
                "three-phase",
                mapOf("v" to "400", "i" to "10", "pf" to "0.8V"),
            ) is Calculation.Error
        )
    }

    /**
     * @return Unit; rejects missing fields and impossible poles, efficiencies and power factors.
     */
    @Test
    fun physicalRanges() {
        tools.forEach {
            assertTrue(EngineeringTools.calculate(it.id, emptyMap()) is Calculation.Error)
        }
        assertTrue(
            EngineeringTools.calculate("slip", mapOf("f" to "50", "poles" to "3", "n" to "975"))
                is Calculation.Error
        )
        assertTrue(
            EngineeringTools.calculate("efficiency", mapOf("out" to "20", "in" to "10"))
                is Calculation.Error
        )
        assertTrue(
            EngineeringTools.calculate(
                "motor-current",
                mapOf("p" to "15", "v" to "415", "pf" to "1.1", "eta" to "91.2"),
            ) is Calculation.Error
        )
    }

    /**
     * Probes every scalar independently while retaining the other explicit example parameters.
     *
     * @return Unit; any exception, generic requirement message or unhandled range error fails.
     */
    @Test
    fun everyNewToolExtremeInputGrid() {
        val probes = listOf("", "0", "-1", "1e-300", "1e300", "NaN", "abc")
        tools.forEach { tool ->
            val baseline = tool.fields.associate { it.key to it.sample }
            assertTrue(
                tool.title,
                EngineeringTools.calculate(tool.id, baseline) is Calculation.Value,
            )
            tool.fields
                .filter { it.options.isEmpty() }
                .forEach { field ->
                    probes.forEach { probe ->
                        val result =
                            EngineeringTools.calculate(tool.id, baseline + (field.key to probe))
                        assertFalse(result.text.contains("Failed requirement."))
                        assertTrue(result.text.isNotBlank())
                    }
                }
        }
    }
    /** @return Unit; verifies generating speed gives negative slip and converts back consistently. */
    @Test
    fun regenerativeSlip() {
        check("slip", mapOf("f" to "50", "poles" to "6", "n" to "1025"), "-2.5%")
        check("frequency-speed", mapOf("f" to "50", "poles" to "6", "slip" to "-2.5"), "1025 rpm")
    }

}
````

## app/src/test/java/com/electrokit/app/domain/FieldUnitTests.kt

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.domain

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

/** Guards field-unit/parser agreement without duplicating the calculator's unit list. */
class FieldUnitTests {
    /**
     * Every numeric field must accept a pasted value bearing its declared unit.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failure identifies a schema/parser drift.
     */
    @Test
    fun everyDeclaredNumericFieldAcceptsItsUnit() {
        for (id in 1..31) for (field in Calculators.spec(id).fields.filter { !it.text }) {
            assertTrue("c$id ${field.key}: ${field.unit}", field.unit in UnitCatalog.fieldUnits)
            val actual = Engineering.input("1${field.unit}", 0, field.unit)
            assertNotNull("c$id ${field.key}: ${field.unit}", actual)
            assertEquals(1.0, actual!!, 1e-12)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Compound dimensions must be recognised before interpreting a leading SI letter.
     *
     * @return Unit; failures expose rejected or mis-scaled physical quantities.
     */
    @Test
    fun compoundQuantitiesAndConversions() {
        assertEquals(10.0, Engineering.input("10m/s", 3, "m/s")!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(20.0, Engineering.input("20°C/W", 0, "°C/W")!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(2.0, Engineering.input("2oz/ft²", 0, "oz/ft²")!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(20.0, Engineering.input("20mA", 0, "mA")!!, 1e-12)
        assertEquals(20.0, Engineering.input("0.02A", 0, "mA")!!, 1e-12)
        assertEquals(2.0, Engineering.input("2000W", 0, "kW")!!, 0.0)
        assertNull(Engineering.input("20°C/W", 0, "m/s"))
    }

    /**
     * The same m token is contextual: metre in a metre field, milli in bare engineering notation.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertions prevent either interpretation from regressing.
     */
    @Test
    fun metresDoNotBreakMilliNotation() {
        assertEquals(0.01, Engineering.parse("10m")!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(10.0, Engineering.input("10m", 3, "m")!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(1000.0, Engineering.input("1km", 0, "m")!!, 0.0)
    }

    /**
     * Already-scaled field/result labels must not be prefixed again.
     *
     * @return Unit; malformed units such as mmm and mmA fail the regression.
     */
    @Test
    fun alreadyScaledUnitsKeepTheirDeclaredLabel() {
        assertEquals("0.2 mm", Engineering.format(0.2, "mm"))
        assertEquals("0.01 mm²", Engineering.format(0.01, "mm²"))
        assertEquals("0.1 mA", Engineering.format(0.1, "mA"))
        assertEquals("1000 mAh", Engineering.format(1000.0, "mAh"))
        assertEquals("0.5 °C", Engineering.format(0.5, "°C"))
        assertEquals("1 kΩ", Engineering.format(1000.0, "Ω"))
    }
}
````

## app/src/test/java/com/electrokit/app/domain/FormattingRegressionTests.kt

````kotlin
package com.electrokit.app.domain

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * Groups regression assertions for formatting regression tests; unexpected behaviour fails the test
 * visibly.
 */
class FormattingRegressionTests {
    /**
     * Verifies percentages are rounded without changing band tolerances; unexpected behaviour fails
     * the test visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun percentagesAreRoundedWithoutChangingBandTolerances() {
        assertEquals("52.38%", Engineering.percent(52.38095238095238))
        assertEquals("9.421%", Engineering.percent(9.421333333333333))
        assertEquals("0.6061%", Engineering.percent(0.60606060606061))
        for (value in listOf(0.5, 0.25, 0.1, 0.05)) assertEquals(
            "$value%",
            Engineering.percent(value),
        )
    }

    /**
     * Verifies default rtd temperature is exactly positive zero; unexpected behaviour fails the
     * test visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun defaultRtdTemperatureIsExactlyPositiveZero() {
        assertEquals(0.0, Circuits.rtdTemperature(100.0, 100.0), 0.0)
        assertEquals(0L, Circuits.rtdTemperature(100.0, 100.0).toBits())
        val spec = Calculators.spec(26)
        assertTrue(
            Calculators.calculate(26, spec.fields.associate { it.key to it.initial })
                .text
                .contains("Temperature: 0 °C")
        )
    }

    /**
     * Verifies unitless values never use engineering prefixes; unexpected behaviour fails the test
     * visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun unitlessValuesNeverUseEngineeringPrefixes() {
        assertEquals("1E+7", Engineering.format(1e7))
        assertEquals("1E-7", Engineering.format(1e-7))
        assertEquals("12.3457 V/V", Engineering.format(12.3456789, "V/V"))
        assertEquals("0", Engineering.format(-0.0))
    }

    /**
     * Verifies smd r notation uses plain decimal digits; unexpected behaviour fails the test
     * visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun smdRNotationUsesPlainDecimalDigits() {
        assertTrue(Resistors.smdCodes(0.0001).contains("0R0001"))
        assertTrue(Resistors.smdCodes(4.7).contains("4R7"))
        assertFalse(Resistors.smdCodes(0.0001).contains("1R0E"))
    }

    /**
     * Verifies mega aliases and micro values are exact; unexpected behaviour fails the test
     * visibly.
     *
     * @return Unit; assertion failures identify regressions and are never swallowed.
     *   Assertion/time-out failures propagate; the failure fixture deliberately throws IOException
     *   while enabled.
     */
    @Test
    fun megaAliasesAndMicroValuesAreExact() {
        assertEquals(1e6, Engineering.parse("1Meg")!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(1e6, Engineering.parse("1MEG")!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(1e-5, Engineering.parse("10u")!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(1e-5, Engineering.parse("10uF")!!, 0.0)
    }
}
````
